words.definition: When someone is afraid, they feel fear.
words.definition_uz: Biror kimsa qo'rqqanda, u xavf yoki vahimani his qiladi.
words.example: The woman was afraid of what she saw.
words.example_uz: Ayol ko'rgan narsasidan qo'rqib ketdi.

words.definition: To agree is to say “yes” or to think the same way.
words.definition_uz: Rozi bo'lmoq - 'ha' deb aytish yoki bir xil fikrlashdir.
words.example: A: The food is very good in that restaurant. B: I agree with you.
words.example_uz: U restoranning taomi juda mazali ekaniga qo'shilaman.

words.definition: When someone is angry, they may want to speak loudly or fight.
words.definition_uz: Birovning jahli chiqqanda, u baland ovozda gapirishi yoki urushishi mumkin.
words.example: She didn’t do her homework, so her father is angry.
words.example_uz: U uy vazifasini qilmadi, shuning uchun otasining jahli chiqdi.

words.definition: To arrive is to get to or reach some place.
words.definition_uz: Yetib kelmoq - biror joyga borish yoki manzilga yetish.
words.example: The bus always arrives at the corner of my street at 4:00.
words.example_uz: Ular avtobus bekatiga soat ikkida yetib kelishdi.

words.definition: To attack is to try to fight or to hurt.
words.definition_uz: Hujum qilmoq - birovga zarar yetkazish uchun kurashga kirishmoq.
words.example: The man with the sword attacked the other man first.
words.example_uz: Odam mayda qora qushning hujumiga uchradi.

words.definition: The bottom is the lowest part.
words.definition_uz: Tub - biror narsaning eng pastki qismidir.
words.example: The bottom of my shoe has a hole in it.
words.example_uz: U tagidagi qutiga sho'ng'iganida, poyabzallarini taglikka qo'ydi.

words.definition: When someone is clever, they can solve a hard puzzle or problem.
words.definition_uz: Aqlli odamlar narsalarni tez va oson tushuna olishadi.
words.example: The clever boy thought of a good idea.
words.example_uz: Aqlli bola qiyin matematik misolni osonlikcha yechdi.

words.definition: When someone is cruel, they do bad things to hurt others.
words.definition_uz: Shafqatsiz odamlar boshqalarga azob berishadi va pushaymon bo'lishmaydi.
words.example: The cruel man yelled at his sister.
words.example_uz: Zolim xo'jayin ishchilarini kun bo'yi tinimsiz ishlatdi.

words.definition: If something happens finally, it happens after a longtime or at the end.
words.definition_uz: Nihoyat - uzoq kutilgan vaqtdan so'ng biror narsa sodir bo'lishi.
words.example: He finally crossed the finish line after five hours of running.
words.example_uz: Uzoq safardan so'ng, nihoyat uyimizga yetib keldik.

words.definition: To hide is to try not to let others see you.
words.definition_uz: Yashirinmoq - birov ko'rmaydigan joyga bekinish.
words.example: The other children will hide while you count to 100.
words.example_uz: Qiz do'stlaridan katta daraxt orqasiga berkinib oldi.

words.definition: To hunt is to look for or search for an animal to kill.
words.definition_uz: Ov qilmoq - hayvonlarni oziq-ovqat yoki sport uchun izlash va tutish.
words.example: Long ago, people hunted with bows and arrows.
words.example_uz: Qadimgi odamlar yashash uchun yovvoyi hayvonlarni ovlashgan.

words.definition: A lot means a large number or amount of people, animals, things, etc.
words.definition_uz: Ko'p - biror narsaning katta miqdori yoki soni.
words.example: There are a lot of apples in the basket.
words.example_uz: Bog'da juda ko'p rang-barang gullar ochilib yotibdi.

words.definition: The middle of something is the center or halfway point.
words.definition_uz: O'rtasi - biror narsaning markaziy qismidir.
words.example: The Canadian flag has a maple leaf in the middle of it.
words.example_uz: Bola xonaning o'rtasida turib qo'shiq ayta boshladi.

words.definition: A moment is a second or a very short time.
words.definition_uz: Lahza - juda qisqa vaqt oralig'i.
words.example: I was only a few moments late for the meeting.
words.example_uz: Bir lahzaga to'xtab, go'zal manzaraga qarab qoldim.

words.definition: When someone is pleased, they are happy.
words.definition_uz: Mamnun bo'lish - biror natijadan baxtiyor va rozi bo'lish.
words.example: She was pleased with the phone call she received.
words.example_uz: O'qituvchi a'lo baho olgan o'quvchisidan juda mamnun bo'ldi.

words.definition: To promise is to say you will do something for sure.
words.definition_uz: Va'da bermoq - biror narsani albatta bajarishini aytish.
words.example: He promised to return my key by tomorrow.
words.example_uz: U ertaga ertalab soat sakkizda kelishga va'da berdi.

words.definition: To reply is to give an answer or say back to someone.
words.definition_uz: Javob bermoq - berilgan savolga so'z yoki xat bilan javob qaytarish.
words.example: She asked him what time his meeting was. He replied, “at three.”
words.example_uz: Mening xatimga u darhol iliq javob qaytardi.

words.definition: When a person is safe, they are not in danger.
words.definition_uz: Xavfsiz - hech qanday xavf yoki zarardan uzoq bo'lgan holat.
words.example: Put on your seat belt in the car to be safe.
words.example_uz: Uyda o'tirganimizda o'zimizni to'liq xavfsiz his qilamiz.

words.definition: A trick is something you do to fool another person.
words.definition_uz: Hiyla - boshqalarni aldash yoki qiziqtirish uchun qilingan aqlli ish.
words.example: His card trick really surprised us.
words.example_uz: Sehrgar tomoshabinlarga hayratlanarli hiyla ko'rsatdi.

words.definition: You use well to say that something was done in a good way.
words.definition_uz: Yaxshi - biror ishni sifatli va to'g'ri bajarish.
words.example: The couple can dance quite well.
words.example_uz: U ingliz tilida juda yaxshi va ravon gapira oladi.

words.definition: An adventure is a fun or exciting thing that you do.
words.definition_uz: Sarguzasht - bu siz qiladigan qiziqarli yoki hayajonli narsa.
words.example: Riding in the rough water was an adventure.
words.example_uz: To'lqinli suvda sayr qilish sarguzasht edi.

words.definition: To approach something means to move close to it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaga yaqinlashish unga yaqinlashishni anglatadi.
words.example: The boy approached his school.
words.example_uz: Bola maktabiga yaqinlashdi.

words.definition: Carefully means with great attention, especially to detail or safety.
words.definition_uz: Ehtiyotkorlik bilan, ayniqsa tafsilotlarga yoki xavfsizlikka katta e'tibor bilan degan ma'noni anglatadi.
words.example: The baby carefully climbed down the stairs.
words.example_uz: Chaqaloq ehtiyotkorlik bilan zinadan tushdi.

words.definition: A chemical is something that scientists use in chemistry.
words.definition_uz: Kimyoviy modda - bu olimlar kimyoda foydalanadigan narsa.
words.example: The scientist mixed the chemicals.
words.example_uz: Olim kimyoviy moddalarni aralashtirdi.

words.definition: To create means to make something new.
words.definition_uz: Yaratish yangi narsa yaratish demakdir.
words.example: She created an igloo from blocks of snow.
words.example_uz: U qor bloklaridan igloo yaratdi.

words.definition: Evil describes something or someone bad or cruel, not good.
words.definition_uz: Yovuzlik biror narsani yoki kimnidir yomon yoki shafqatsiz, yaxshi emas, deb ta'riflaydi.
words.example: The evil figure scared us all.
words.example_uz: Yovuz qiyofasi barchamizni qo'rqitdi.

words.definition: An experiment is a test that you do to see what will happen.
words.definition_uz: Tajriba - bu nima bo'lishini ko'rish uchun bajaradigan sinov.
words.example: The student did an experiment in science class.
words.example_uz: Talaba fan darsida tajriba o'tkazdi.

words.definition: To kill someone or something is to make them die.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki biror narsani o'ldirish uni o'ldirish demakdir.
words.example: I killed the fly with a fly swatter.
words.example_uz: Men pashshani pashsha uchirgich bilan o'ldirdim.

words.definition: A laboratory is a room where a scientist works.
words.definition_uz: Laboratoriya - bu olim ishlaydigan xona.
words.example: My mother works in a laboratory.
words.example_uz: Onam laboratoriyada ishlaydi.

words.definition: Laugh is the sound made when someone is happy or a funny thing occurs.
words.definition_uz: Kulgi - bu kimdir xursand bo'lganida yoki kulgili bir narsa yuz berganda chiqadigan ovoz.
words.example: The sound of their laugh filled the room.
words.example_uz: Ularning kulgi ovozi xonani to'ldirdi.

words.definition: If a sound is loud, it is strong and very easy to hear.
words.definition_uz: Agar tovush baland bo'lsa, u kuchli va eshitish juda oson.
words.example: The man’s voice was so loud that we all could hear him.
words.example_uz: Erkakning ovozi shunchalik baland ediki, hammamiz uni eshita olardik.

words.definition: When a person is nervous, they think something bad will happen.
words.definition_uz: Inson asabiylashganda, u biron yomon narsa bo'ladi deb o'ylaydi.
words.example: The boy became nervous when he heard the news.
words.example_uz: Bola bu xabarni eshitib, asabiylashdi.

words.definition: A noise is an unpleasant sound.
words.definition_uz: Shovqin yoqimsiz tovushdir.
words.example: The crying baby made a loud noise.
words.example_uz: Yig'layotgan chaqaloq baland ovoz chiqardi.

words.definition: A project is a type of work that you do for school ora job.
words.definition_uz: Loyiha - bu siz maktab yoki ish uchun bajaradigan ish turi.
words.example: His afternoon work project was to paint the room green.
words.example_uz: Uning tushdan keyingi ishi xonani yashil rangga bo'yash edi.

words.definition: To scare someone is to make them feel afraid.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir qo'rqitish, ularni qo'rqitish demakdir.
words.example: My uncle was scared by what he saw in the room.
words.example_uz: Amakim xonada ko'rgan narsasidan qo'rqib ketdi.

words.definition: A secret is something that you do not tell other people.
words.definition_uz: Sir - bu siz boshqa odamlarga aytmaydigan narsa.
words.example: The two boys were sharing a secret.
words.example_uz: Ikki bola sirni baham ko'rishardi.

words.definition: To shout is to say something loudly.
words.definition_uz: Baqirish - bu biror narsani baland ovozda aytish.
words.example: My boss shouted at me because I was late for work.
words.example_uz: Ishga kechikkanim uchun xo'jayinim menga baqirdi.

words.definition: To smell something means to use your nose to sense it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani hidlash, uni sezish uchun burningizdan foydalanishni anglatadi.
words.example: The two friends smelled the flower.
words.example_uz: Ikki do'st gulning hidini sezdilar.

words.definition: If something is terrible, it is very bad.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa dahshatli bo'lsa, u juda yomon.
words.example: The way he treated his classmate was terrible.
words.example_uz: Uning sinfdoshiga qilgan munosabati dahshatli edi.

words.definition: If something is worse, it is of poorer quality than another thing.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa yomonroq bo'lsa, demak, u boshqa narsaga qaraganda sifatsizroq.
words.example: Business was worse this month than last month.
words.example_uz: Bu oyda biznes o'tgan oyga qaraganda yomonroq bo'ldi.

words.definition: An alien is a creature from a different world.
words.definition_uz: O'zga sayyoralik — bu boshqa olamdan kelgan mavjudotdir.
words.example: The alien came in peace.
words.example_uz: O'zga sayyoralik tinchlik niyati bilan keldi.

words.definition: If you are among certain things, they are all around you.
words.definition_uz: Agar siz ma'lum narsalar orasida bo'lsangiz, ular sizning atrofingizda.
words.example: There was a red apple among the green ones.
words.example_uz: Yashil olmalar orasida qizil olma bor edi.

words.definition: A chart is a list of information.
words.definition_uz: Grafik - bu ma'lumotlar ro'yxati.
words.example: We used a chart to see how we had improved.
words.example_uz: Biz qanday yaxshilanganimizni ko'rish uchun grafikdan foydalandik.

words.definition: A cloud is a group of water drops in the sky.
words.definition_uz: Bulut - bu osmondagi suv tomchilari guruhi.
words.example: The sky was filled with white clouds.
words.example_uz: Osmon oq bulutlar bilan to'lgan edi.

words.definition: To comprehend something is to understand it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani tushunish uni tushunish demakdir.
words.example: Henry could not comprehend the message.
words.example_uz: Genri xabarni tushuna olmadi.

words.definition: To describe is to say or write what someone or something is like.
words.definition_uz: Ta'riflash - bu kimdir yoki biror narsaning qanday ekanligini aytish yoki yozish.
words.example: They described their tree as colorful with gold ribbon and a star.
words.example_uz: Ular o'z daraxtlarini oltin lenta va yulduzcha bilan bezatilgan rang-barang deb ta'riflashgan.

words.definition: Ever means at any time.
words.definition_uz: Har doim, istalgan vaqtda degani.
words.example: Going skiing last winter was the most fun I’ve ever had.
words.example_uz: O'tgan qishda chang'i uchish men uchun eng qiziqarli bo'ldi.

words.definition: To fail means you do not succeed in what you try to do.
words.definition_uz: Muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash, qilmoqchi bo'lgan narsangizda muvaffaqiyat qozona olmasligingizni anglatadi.
words.example: Since he failed to get the job, he was sad.
words.example_uz: U ishga kira olmagani uchun xafa bo'ldi.

words.definition: Friendly is behaving in a pleasant, kind way toward someone.
words.definition_uz: Do'stona munosabat - bu kimgadir yoqimli va mehribon munosabatda bo'lish.
words.example: The friendly animals came up to the girl.
words.example_uz: Do'stona hayvonlar qizning oldiga kelishdi.

words.definition: A grade is a score or mark given to someone’s work.
words.definition_uz: Baho - bu kimningdir ishiga berilgan ball yoki baho.
words.example: I managed to get good grades on my report card.
words.example_uz: Men hisobot varaqamda yaxshi baholar olishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

words.definition: Instead means in place of.
words.definition_uz: Buning o'rniga.
words.example: He ate the carrot instead of the ice cream.
words.example_uz: o'rniga degan ma'noni anglatadi. U muzqaymoq o'rniga sabzi yedi.

words.definition: A library is a place where you go to read books.
words.definition_uz: Kutubxona - bu siz kitob o'qish uchun boradigan joy.
words.example: The library at school is full of books.
words.example_uz: Maktabdagi kutubxona kitoblarga to'la.

words.definition: A planet is a large round thing in space.
words.definition_uz: Sayyora - bu kosmosdagi katta dumaloq narsa.
words.example: Saturn is the planet with the ring around it.
words.example_uz: Saturn - bu atrofida halqasi bo'lgan sayyora.

words.definition: A report is something students write for school.
words.definition_uz: Hisobot - bu o'quvchilar maktab uchun yozadigan narsa.
words.example: Karen had trouble writing her report.
words.example_uz: Karen hisobot yozishda qiynaldi.

words.definition: Several is more than two but not many.
words.definition_uz: Bir nechtasi ikkitadan ko'p, lekin ko'p emas.
words.example: He had to read several books for class.
words.example_uz: U dars uchun bir nechta kitob o'qishi kerak edi.

words.definition: To solve something is to find an answer to it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani hal qilish, unga javob topish demakdir.
words.example: All the students could easily solve the math problem.
words.example_uz: Barcha o'quvchilar matematik masalani osongina yechishlari mumkin edi.

words.definition: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa to'satdan sodir bo'lsa, u tez va kutilmaganda sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: I was suddenly surprised by the cake my friends brought me.
words.example_uz: Do'stlarim olib kelgan tort meni to'satdan hayratda qoldirdi.

words.definition: To suppose is to guess.
words.definition_uz: Taxmin qilish - taxmin qilish.
words.example: I suppose I should go home now.
words.example_uz: Menimcha, hozir uyga ketishim kerak.

words.definition: The universe is the known or supposed objects in space.
words.definition_uz: Koinot - bu kosmosdagi ma'lum yoki taxmin qilingan obyektlar.
words.example: The universe is so large that it cannot be measured.
words.example_uz: Koinot shunchalik kattaki, uni o'lchab bo'lmaydi.

words.definition: To view is to look at something.
words.definition_uz: Ko'rish - bu biror narsaga qarash.
words.example: Michael likes to view himself in the mirror.
words.example_uz: Maykl o'zini oynada ko'rishni yaxshi ko'radi.

words.definition: When a thing is appropriate, it is right or normal.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsa o'rinli bo'lsa, u to'g'ri yoki normal hisoblanadi.
words.example: It’s appropriate to wear a suit when you go to the office.
words.example_uz: Ofisga borganingizda kostyum kiyish o'rinli.

words.definition: To avoid something is to stay away from it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsadan qochish, undan uzoqroq turish demakdir.
words.example: Avoid the broken bottle on the floor.
words.example_uz: Polda yotgan singan shishadan qoching.

words.definition: To behave is to act in a particular way, especially to be good.
words.definition_uz: O'zini tutish - bu o'ziga xos tarzda harakat qilish, ayniqsa yaxshi bo'lish demakdir.
words.example: She always behaves well when her father is around.
words.example_uz: U otasi yonida bo'lganida har doim o'zini yaxshi tutadi.

words.definition: When someone is calm, they do not get excited or upset.
words.definition_uz: Kimdir xotirjam bo'lganda, u hayajonlanmaydi yoki xafa bo'lmaydi.
words.example: A nice warm bath makes me feel so calm.
words.example_uz: Yaxshi iliq vanna menga o'zimni juda xotirjam his qilishimga yordam beradi.

words.definition: Concern is a feeling of worry.
words.definition_uz: Xavotir - bu xavotir hissi.
words.example: I was filled with concern after reading the newspaper.
words.example_uz: Gazetani o'qib bo'lgach, men xavotirga to'ldim.

words.definition: To be content is to be happy and not want more.
words.definition_uz: Qanoatli bo'lish - bu baxtli bo'lish va boshqasini xohlamaslik demakdir.
words.example: The baby looked very content sitting on the floor.
words.example_uz: Chaqaloq polda o'tirganidan juda mamnun ko'rinardi.

words.definition: If you expect something to happen, you believe it will happen.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa sodir bo'lishini kutsangiz, uning sodir bo'lishiga ishonasiz.
words.example: I expect the bus to be here very soon.
words.example_uz: Men avtobusning juda tez orada yetib kelishini kutaman.

words.definition: When something happens frequently, it happens often.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsa tez-tez sodir bo'lganda, u tez-tez sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: We meet frequently, either at the beginning or ending of the week.
words.example_uz: Biz haftaning boshida yoki oxirida tez-tez uchrashamiz.

words.definition: A habit is a thing that you do often.
words.definition_uz: Odat - bu siz tez-tez qiladigan narsa.
words.example: Smoking is a bad habit that can kill you.
words.example_uz: Chekish sizni o'ldirishi mumkin bo'lgan yomon odatdir.

words.definition: To instruct is to teach.
words.definition_uz: O'rgatish - bu o'rgatish.
words.example: My teacher instructs us in several subjects.
words.example_uz: O'qituvchim bizga bir nechta fanlardan dars beradi.

words.definition: An issue is an important topic.
words.definition_uz: Muammo muhim mavzu.
words.example: The men spoke about issues that were important to the people.
words.example_uz: Erkaklar xalq uchun muhim bo'lgan masalalar haqida gapirishdi.

words.definition: None means not any of someone or something.
words.definition_uz: "Yo'q" so'zi hech kimni yoki biror narsani anglatmaydi.
words.example: He spent all his money. There is none left.
words.example_uz: U barcha pulini sarfladi. Hech narsa qolmadi.

words.definition: If a person is patient, they don’t become angry or upset easily.
words.definition_uz: Agar inson sabrli bo'lsa, u osongina jahli chiqmaydi yoki xafa bo'lmaydi.
words.example: I had to be patient and wait until 5 o’clock to leave.
words.example_uz: Men sabrli bo'lishim va ketish uchun soat 5 gacha kutishim kerak edi.

words.definition: If something is positive, it is good.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa ijobiy bo'lsa, bu yaxshi.
words.example: She has a positive future ahead of her after finishing college.
words.example_uz: Kollejni tugatgandan keyin uni oldinda ijobiy kelajak kutmoqda.

words.definition: To punish means to make someone suffer for breaking the rules or laws.
words.definition_uz: Jazolash - bu kimnidir qoidalar yoki qonunlarni buzgani uchun azob chekish demakdir.
words.example: To punish me, my teacher had me stand in the corner.
words.example_uz: Meni jazolash uchun o'qituvchim meni burchakka turg'izib qo'ydi.

words.definition: To represent is to speak or act for a person or group.
words.definition_uz: Vakillik qilish - bu shaxs yoki guruh nomidan gapirish yoki harakat qilishdir.
words.example: My lawyer will represent me in court.
words.example_uz: Mening advokatim meni sudda himoya qiladi.

words.definition: To shake is to move back and forth or up and down quickly.
words.definition_uz: Qo'l berib ko'rishish - bu tez oldinga va orqaga yoki yuqoriga va pastga harakatlanishdir.
words.example: When people shake hands, it usually means they agree.
words.example_uz: Odamlar qo'l berib ko'rishganda, bu odatda ularning rozi bo'lishlarini anglatadi.

words.definition: To spread is to move quickly to more places.
words.definition_uz: Yoyish - bu tezda ko'proq joylarga ko'chib o'tish demakdir.
words.example: I like to spread butter on my toast.
words.example_uz: Men tostlarimga sariyog' surtishni yaxshi ko'raman.

words.definition: To stroll means to walk slowly and calmly.
words.definition_uz: Sayr qilish sekin va xotirjam yurishni anglatadi.
words.example: My dog and I strolled through the park today.
words.example_uz: Bugun itim bilan parkda sayr qildik.

words.definition: A village is a very small town.
words.definition_uz: Qishloq juda kichik shaharcha.
words.example: There are only a few houses in my village.
words.example_uz: Mening qishlog'imda atigi bir nechta uy bor.

words.definition: If you are aware of something, you know about it.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsadan xabardor bo'lsangiz, demak u haqida bilasiz.
words.example: I was not aware of the ringing phone.
words.example_uz: Men telefon jiringlayotganini bilmasdim.

words.definition: Badly means in a severe or harmful way.
words.definition_uz: Yomon ma'noda, jiddiy yoki zararli ma'noda.
words.example: He hurt his arm badly playing with friends.
words.example_uz: U do'stlari bilan o'ynab, qo'lini qattiq jarohatladi.

words.definition: If something belongs to you, you own it.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa sizga tegishli bo'lsa, u sizga tegishli.
words.example: The blue suit belongs to Paul.
words.example_uz: Moviy kostyum Polga tegishli.

words.definition: To continue something is to keep doing it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani davom ettirish, uni davom ettirish demakdir.
words.example: She stood under her umbrella as the rain continued to fall.
words.example_uz: Yomg'ir yog'ishda davom etar ekan, u soyaboni ostida turdi.

words.definition: An error is something you do wrong.
words.definition_uz: Xatolik - bu siz noto'g'ri qilgan narsa.
words.example: I made an error on my report, so my boss was angry.
words.example_uz: Men hisobotimda xatoga yo'l qo'ydim, shuning uchun xo'jayinim g'azablandi.

words.definition: An experience is something you have seen or done.
words.definition_uz: Tajriba - bu siz ko'rgan yoki qilgan narsa.
words.example: Rock climbing was a fun experience.
words.example_uz: Toshga chiqish qiziqarli tajriba bo'ldi.

words.definition: A field is a big area of land.
words.definition_uz: Dala - bu katta yer maydoni.
words.example: The field of flowers looked so pretty.
words.example_uz: Gullar maydoni juda chiroyli ko'rinardi.

words.definition: To hurt is to do something that makes you feel pain.
words.definition_uz: Og'riq keltirish - bu sizga og'riq keltiradigan biror narsa qilishdir.
words.example: She hurt her leg falling down the stairs.
words.example_uz: U zinadan yiqilib oyog'ini jarohatladi.

words.definition: Judgment is the ability to form opinions or decisions.
words.definition_uz: Hukm qilish - bu fikr yoki qarorlar qabul qilish qobiliyatidir.
words.example: It’s good judgment to recycle your aluminum cans.
words.example_uz: Alyuminiy qutilaringizni qayta ishlash yaxshi fikrlashdir.

words.definition: If something likely happens, it will probably happen.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa yuz berishi mumkin bo'lsa, u albatta sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: I will likely stay at home and watch TV tonight.
words.example_uz: Men bugun kechqurun uyda qolib, televizor ko'raman.

words.definition: If something is normal, it is not strange nor surprising to you.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa normal bo'lsa, bu siz uchun g'alati yoki ajablanarli emas.
words.example: It is normal for me to bathe every night.
words.example_uz: Men uchun har kecha cho'milish odatiy hol.

words.definition: If something is rare, you do not see it very often.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa kamdan-kam uchraydigan bo'lsa, uni tez-tez ko'rmaysiz.
words.example: It is rare for him to miss his flight.
words.example_uz: Uning parvozini o'tkazib yuborishi kamdan-kam uchraydi.

words.definition: To relax is to rest.
words.definition_uz: Dam olish - bu dam olish.
words.example: The frog relaxed in the warm sun.
words.example_uz: Baqa iliq quyoshda dam oldi.

words.definition: To request something is to ask for it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsa so'rash, uni so'rash demakdir.
words.example: The little girl requested a special gift from Santa Claus.
words.example_uz: Kichkina qiz Santa Klausdan maxsus sovg'a so'radi.

words.definition: To reside means to live somewhere permanently or for a long time.
words.definition_uz: Yashash deganda biror joyda doimiy yoki uzoq vaqt yashash tushuniladi.
words.example: My brother and his family reside in a lovely house on the beach.
words.example_uz: Akam va uning oilasi plyajdagi yoqimli uyda yashaydi.

words.definition: A result is something that happens because of something else.
words.definition_uz: Natija - bu boshqa narsa tufayli sodir bo'ladigan narsa.
words.example: Asa result of all the rain, the man had to climb on the roof.
words.example_uz: Yomg'ir natijasida odam tomga chiqishi kerak edi.

words.definition: To roll is to move by turning over and over.
words.definition_uz: To'pni ag'darib, harakatlanish demakdir.
words.example: You must roll the ball into the pins when you bowl.
words.example_uz: To'pni to'pni to'pga uloqtirganingizda uni pinlarga tashlashingiz kerak.

words.definition: Since is used to talk about a past event still happening now.
words.definition_uz: Since o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va hozir ham sodir bo'layotgan voqea haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example: Since 1992, he has been driving that car.
words.example_uz: 1992-yildan beri u o'sha mashinani boshqarib kelmoqda.

words.definition: If something is visible, it can be seen.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa ko'rinadigan bo'lsa, uni ko'rish mumkin.
words.example: The moon and stars were visible in the night sky.
words.example_uz: Oy va yulduzlar tungi osmonda ko'rinib turardi.

words.definition: If something is wild, it is found in nature.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa yovvoyi bo'lsa, u tabiatda uchraydi.
words.example: You should be careful around a fox, because it is a wild animal.
words.example_uz: Tulkining yonida ehtiyot bo'lishingiz kerak, chunki u yovvoyi hayvon.

words.definition: An advantage is something that helps you.
words.definition_uz: Afzallik - bu sizga yordam beradigan narsa.
words.example: Being tall is an advantage to a basketball player.
words.example_uz: Baland bo'yli bo'lish basketbolchi uchun afzallikdir.

words.definition: To cause is to make something happen.
words.definition_uz: Sabab bo'lish - bu biror narsa sodir bo'lishiga sabab bo'lish.
words.example: The cold weather caused her to get sick.
words.example_uz: Sovuq ob-havo uning kasal bo'lishiga sabab bo'ldi.

words.definition: A choice is the act or possibility of picking something.
words.definition_uz: Tanlov - bu biror narsani tanlash harakati yoki imkoniyati.
words.example: I had my choice of five doors to open.
words.example_uz: Men ochish uchun beshta eshikdan birini tanlashim kerak edi.

words.definition: A community is a group of people who live together.
words.definition_uz: Jamiyat - bu birga yashaydigan odamlar guruhi.
words.example: The kids from my community usually play together.
words.example_uz: Mening jamoamdagi bolalar odatda birga o'ynashadi.

words.definition: To be dead is to not be alive.
words.definition_uz: O'lik bo'lish - tirik bo'lmaslik.
words.example: A dead person is usually buried in the ground.
words.example_uz: O'lgan odam odatda yerga ko'miladi.

words.definition: The distance between two things is how far it is between them.
words.definition_uz: Ikki narsa orasidagi masofa ularning orasidagi masofadir.
words.example: The distance between the Earth and the Moon is 384,400 kilometers.
words.example_uz: Yer va Oy orasidagi masofa 384 400 kilometrni tashkil qiladi.

words.definition: To escape is to run away from something bad.
words.definition_uz: Qochish yomon narsadan qochish demakdir.
words.example: The butterfly could not escape from the cage.
words.example_uz: Kapalak qafasdan qochib qutula olmadi.

words.definition: If you face a problem, you deal with it.
words.definition_uz: Agar muammoga duch kelsangiz, uni hal qilasiz.
words.example: My sister and I have to find a better way to face our differences.
words.example_uz: Singlim va men kelishmovchiliklarimizni hal qilishning yaxshiroq yo'lini topishimiz kerak.

words.definition: To follow means to go behind someone and go where they go.
words.definition_uz: "Ergashish" deganda kimningdir orqasidan borish va u boradigan joyga borish tushuniladi.
words.example: The little boy followed his mother home.
words.example_uz: Kichkina bola onasining orqasidan uyga qaytdi.

words.definition: Fright is the feeling of being scared.
words.definition_uz: Qo'rquv - bu qo'rquv hissi.
words.example: She was filled with fright.
words.example_uz: U qo'rquvga to'lgan edi.

words.definition: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person.
words.definition_uz: Arvoh - bu o'lgan odamning ruhi.
words.example: Many people are afraid of ghosts.
words.example_uz: Ko'p odamlar arvohlardan qo'rqishadi.

words.definition: An individual is one person.
words.definition_uz: Shaxs bitta odam.
words.example: Only one individual could win the bicycle race.
words.example_uz: Velosiped poygasida faqat bitta odam g'alaba qozonishi mumkin.

words.definition: A pet is an animal that lives with people.
words.definition_uz: Uy hayvoni - bu odamlar bilan birga yashaydigan hayvon.
words.example: Out of all my pets, the dog is my favorite.
words.example_uz: Mening barcha uy hayvonlarim orasida it mening eng sevimlim.

words.definition: To reach means to arrive at a place.
words.definition_uz: Yetib borish - bir joyga yetib borish demakdir.
words.example: I was happy to finally reach my destination.
words.example_uz: Nihoyat manzilimga yetib borganimdan xursand bo'ldim.

words.definition: To return is to go back to a place.
words.definition_uz: Qaytish - bu bir joyga qaytish.
words.example: I was happy to return home to my mom after school.
words.example_uz: Maktabdan keyin onamnikiga uyga qaytganimdan xursand edim.

words.definition: To survive is to stay alive.
words.definition_uz: Omon qolish - tirik qolish demakdir.
words.example: My dog survived her fall into the water.
words.example_uz: Mening itim suvga yiqilganidan keyin omon qoldi.

words.definition: To be upset is to be unhappy about something.
words.definition_uz: Xafa bo'lish - bu biror narsadan norozi bo'lish.
words.example: She was upset because she broke her toy.
words.example_uz: U o'yinchog'ini sindirib olgani uchun xafa bo'ldi.

words.definition: A voice is the sound a person makes when they talk or sing.
words.definition_uz: Ovoz - bu odam gapirganda yoki qo'shiq aytganda chiqaradigan tovush.
words.example: He used a microphone, so everyone could hear his voice.
words.example_uz: U hamma uning ovozini eshitishi uchun mikrofondan foydalangan.

words.definition: The weather is the condition of the air: hot, rainy, windy, etc.
words.definition_uz: Ob-havo - bu havoning holati: issiq, yomg'irli, shamolli va boshqalar.
words.example: The weather can be sunny, rainy, or cold.
words.example_uz: Ob-havo quyoshli, yomg'irli yoki sovuq bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definition: To be wise is to use experience and intelligence to make good choices.
words.definition_uz: Dono bo'lish - bu to'g'ri tanlov qilish uchun tajriba va aql-zakovatdan foydalanishdir.
words.example: Many people believe that owls are very wise animals.
words.example_uz: Ko'p odamlar boyqushlar juda dono hayvonlar deb hisoblashadi.

words.definition: To allow something to happen means to let it happen.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaning sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'yish, uning sodir bo'lishiga yo'l qo'yish demakdir.
words.example: Having a ticket will allow you to enter the show.
words.example_uz: Chiptaga ega bo'lish sizga shouga kirishga imkon beradi.

words.definition: To announce something is to make it known.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani e'lon qilish uni ma'lum qilish demakdir.
words.example: He announced to everyone his new idea for the company.
words.example_uz: U kompaniya uchun yangi g'oyasini hammaga e'lon qildi.

words.definition: When someone or something is beside you, they are next to you.
words.definition_uz: Kimdir yoki biror narsa yoningizda bo'lsa, u sizning yoningizda bo'ladi.
words.example: The two brothers stood beside each other.
words.example_uz: Ikki aka-uka bir-birining yoniga turishdi.

words.definition: A challenge is something difficult to complete.
words.definition_uz: Qiyinchilik - bu bajarish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.
words.example: It was a challenge to climb to the top of the mountain.
words.example_uz: Tog' cho'qqisiga chiqish qiyin edi.

words.definition: To claim means to say that something is true.
words.definition_uz: Da'vo qilish, biror narsa haqiqat ekanligini aytish demakdir.
words.example: He claimed to know why the country’s laws were weak.
words.example_uz: U mamlakat qonunlari nima uchun zaif ekanligini bilishini da'vo qildi.

words.definition: The condition of someone or something is the state that they are in.
words.definition_uz: Kimdir yoki biror narsaning holati - bu ularning hozirgi holati.
words.example: The patient’s condition was very good.
words.example_uz: Bemorning ahvoli juda yaxshi edi.

words.definition: To contribute to something means to do something to make it successful.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaga hissa qo'shish, uni muvaffaqiyatli qilish uchun biror narsa qilish demakdir.
words.example: We decided to contribute money to the new hospital.
words.example_uz: Biz yangi kasalxonaga pul qo'shishga qaror qildik.

words.definition: A difference is a way that something is not like other things.
words.definition_uz: Farq - bu biror narsaning boshqa narsalarga o'xshamasligidir.
words.example: The biggest difference between the birds is the color of their feathers.
words.example_uz: Qushlar orasidagi eng katta farq ularning patlarining rangidir.

words.definition: To divide something is to make it into smaller parts.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani bo'lish uni kichikroq qismlarga ajratish demakdir.
words.example: We divided the pizza.
words.example_uz: Biz pitsani bo'ldik.

words.definition: An expert is someone who is very good at doing something.
words.definition_uz: Mutaxassis - bu biror narsani qilishda juda mohir bo'lgan kishi.
words.example: The wizard was an expert at magic.
words.example_uz: Sehrgar sehrgarlikda mohir edi.

words.definition: If someone or something is famous, they are known to many people.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki biror narsa mashhur bo'lsa, u ko'p odamlarga ma'lum.
words.example: The Eiffel Tower in Paris is very famous.
words.example_uz: Parijdagi Eyfel minorasi juda mashhur.

words.definition: Force is a person’s strength or power.
words.definition_uz: Kuch - bu insonning kuchi yoki kuchi.
words.example: He used all his force to try and open the door.
words.example_uz: U eshikni ochishga harakat qilish uchun bor kuchini sarfladi.

words.definition: Harm is hurt or problems caused to someone or something.
words.definition_uz: Zarar - bu kimgadir yoki biror narsaga yetkazilgan zarar yoki muammolar.
words.example: A hot iron can cause great harm if you are not careful.
words.example_uz: Agar ehtiyot bo'lmasangiz, issiq dazmol katta zarar etkazishi mumkin.

words.definition: To lay means to put or place in a horizontal or flat position.
words.definition_uz: "Yotmoq" so'zi gorizontal yoki tekis holatga qo'yish yoki joylashtirishni anglatadi.
words.example: Don’t lay your socks on the floor.
words.example_uz: Paypoqlaringizni yerga qo'ymang.

words.definition: Peace is a time without war.
words.definition_uz: Tinchlik - bu urushsiz davr.
words.example: A white dove is a symbol for peace.
words.example_uz: Oq kaptar tinchlik ramzidir.

words.definition: A prince is the son of a king.
words.definition_uz: Shahzoda - bu qirolning o'g'li.
words.example: The prince and the princess were married.
words.example_uz: Shahzoda va malika turmush qurishgan.

words.definition: To protect someone is to stop them from getting hurt.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir himoya qilish, uning jarohat olishining oldini olish demakdir.
words.example: Firemen protect us from fires.
words.example_uz: O't o'chiruvchilar bizni yong'inlardan himoya qiladi.

words.definition: To sense something is to know about it without being told.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani sezish, bu haqda hech kimga aytilmasdan bilish demakdir.
words.example: I could sense that he was watching me.
words.example_uz: Men uning meni kuzatayotganini sezdim.

words.definition: When something is sudden, it happens very quickly.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsa to'satdan sodir bo'lganda, bu juda tez sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: He felt a sudden pain in his chest.
words.example_uz: U ko'kragida to'satdan og'riqni his qildi.

words.definition: Therefore means for this reason.
words.definition_uz: Shuning uchun bu ma'noni anglatadi.
words.example: He is fat. Therefore, he will go on a diet.
words.example_uz: U semiz. Shuning uchun u parhezga o'tadi.

words.definition: To accept something that is offered is to take it.
words.definition_uz: Taklif qilingan narsani qabul qilish, uni olish demakdir.
words.example: I accepted the girl’s very nice gift.
words.example_uz: Men qizning juda yoqimli sovg'asini qabul qildim.

words.definition: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.
words.definition_uz: Narsalarni tartibga solish ularni to'g'ri joyga qo'yish demakdir.
words.example: Please arrange the bowling pins in order so we can play.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, bouling pinlarini o'ynashimiz uchun tartibda joylashtiring.

words.definition: To attend something is to go to it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaga borish, unga borish demakdir.
words.example: My sister and I attend the same school.
words.example_uz: Singlim bilan men bir maktabda o'qiymiz.

words.definition: To balance something is to keep it from falling.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsani muvozanatlash uning yiqilib tushishining oldini olish demakdir.
words.example: We saw an elephant balance itself on a ball.
words.example_uz: Biz filning to'p ustida muvozanatini saqlayotganini ko'rdik.

words.definition: A contrast is the sharp difference between two things.
words.definition_uz: Qarama-qarshilik - bu ikki narsa o'rtasidagi keskin farq.
words.example: The contrast between my parents is very noticeable.
words.example_uz: Ota-onam o'rtasidagi farq juda sezilarli.

words.definition: To encourage someone is to make them want to do something.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir rag'batlantirish, ularni biror narsa qilishga undash demakdir.
words.example: My football coach will encourage us when we are losing.
words.example_uz: Futbol murabbiyim biz yutqazayotganimizda bizni ruhlantiradi.

words.definition: If someone or something is familiar to you, you know them well.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki nimadir sizga tanish bo'lsa, uni yaxshi bilasiz.
words.example: The two friends were very familiar with each other.
words.example_uz: Ikkala do'st bir-birini juda yaxshi tanish edi.

words.definition: To grab is to take a hold of someone or something suddenly.
words.definition_uz: Ushlash — birdaniga kimnidir yoki nimanidir ushlashdir.
words.example: I grabbed a pear from the tree.
words.example_uz: Men daraxtdan nok oldim.

words.definition: To hang something is to keep it above the ground.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir osish — uni yer ustida ushlab turishdir.
words.example: I drew a picture of my family, and my mother hung it on the wall.
words.example_uz: Men oilamning suratini chizdim, onam uni devorga osib qo'ydi.

words.definition: If something is huge, it is very big.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir juda katta bo'lsa, u juda katta.
words.example: At work, my father drives a huge truck.
words.example_uz: Ishda otam katta yuk mashinasini haydaydi.

words.definition: If something is necessary, you must do it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir zarur bo'lsa, uni qilishing kerak.
words.example: It is necessary to have a passport when you travel to a foreign country.
words.example_uz: Xorijiy mamlakatga sayohat qilganingizda pasportga ega bo'lish zarur.

words.definition: A pattern is a way in which something is done or organized.
words.definition_uz: Naqsh — bu biror narsani amalga oshirish yoki tashkil etish usuli.
words.example: My pattern of brushing my teeth is the same as most people’s.
words.example_uz: Mening tishlarimni yuvish uslubim ko'pchiliknikiga o'xshaydi.

words.definition: To propose something is to say that it should be done.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir taklif qilish — bu amalga oshirilishi kerakligini aytishdir.
words.example: Santa Claus proposed that I try to be a good boy all year.
words.example_uz: Santa Klaus butun yil yaxshi bola bo'lishga harakat qilishimni taklif qildi.

words.definition: A purpose is the reason that you do something.
words.definition_uz: Maqsad — bu nimanidir qilishning sababi.
words.example: The purpose of exercising is to get into shape.
words.example_uz: Mashq qilishning maqsadi shaklga kirishdir.

words.definition: To release something is to stop holding it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir ozod qilish uni ushlab turishni to'xtatishdir.
words.example: She released the bird from her hands.
words.example_uz: U qushni qo'lidan qo'yib yubordi.

words.definition: To require something is to say that it is necessary.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir talab qilish, uni zarur deb aytishdir.
words.example: We require teachers to have a university degree.
words.example_uz: Biz o'qituvchilardan universitet diplomiga ega bo'lishni talab qilamiz.

words.definition: If something is single, then there is only one.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yagona bo'lsa, unda faqat bitta mavjud.
words.example: I have a single key in my hand.
words.example_uz: Qo'limda bitta kalit bor.

words.definition: Success is doing something well that you choose to do.
words.definition_uz: Muvaffaqiyat — o'zing tanlagan ishni yaxshi bajarishdir.
words.example: My daughter was a big success at school.
words.example_uz: Qizim maktabda katta muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

words.definition: To tear something means to pull it apart.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir yirtish uni parchalash degani.
words.example: It is easy to tear paper.
words.example_uz: Qog'ozni yirtish oson.

words.definition: A theory is an idea about how something works.
words.definition_uz: Nazariya — bu nimadir qanday ishlashi haqidagi g'oya.
words.example: We talked about Einstein’s theory of relativity in class.
words.example_uz: Biz darsda Eynshteynning nisbiylik nazariyasi haqida gaplashdik.

words.definition: To be against something is to be touching it or opposed to it.
words.definition_uz: Nimagadir qarshi bo'lish uni tegish yoki unga qarshi turishdir.
words.example: They both leaned against the wall.
words.example_uz: Ikkalasi ham devorga suyanib turishdi.

words.definition: The beach is a sandy or rocky place by the ocean.
words.definition_uz: Plyaj okean bo'yidagi qumli yoki toshli joy.
words.example: The little girl built a sandcastle on the beach.
words.example_uz: Kichkina qiz plyajda qum qal'asi qurdi.

words.definition: To damage something is to break it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir shikastlash uni sindirishdir.
words.example: The car was damaged in the accident.
words.example_uz: Avtomobil avariyada shikastlangan.

words.definition: To discover something is to find it for the first time.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir kashf etish — uni birinchi marta topishdir.
words.example: I discovered some new information in this book!
words.example_uz: Men bu kitobda yangi ma'lumot topdim!

words.definition: An emotion is how you feel.
words.definition_uz: His-tuyg'u — bu sen qanday his qilasan.
words.example: Anger is a common emotion that we all feel.
words.example_uz: G'azab hammamiz his qiladigan umumiy his-tuyg'u.

words.definition: To fix something is to make it work.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani tuzatish uni ishlatishdir.
words.example: My dad has many tools to help him fix broken things.
words.example_uz: Dadamda buzilgan narsalarni tuzatish uchun ko'plab asboblar bor.

words.definition: If you are frank, you are being very honest.
words.definition_uz: Agar rostgo'y bo'lsang, juda halol gapiryapsan.
words.example: The teacher had a frank discussion with her students.
words.example_uz: O'qituvchi o'quvchilari bilan ochiq suhbatlashdi.

words.definition: To identify something is to be able to name it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir aniqlash — uni nomlash qobiliyatidir.
words.example: I used the file to identify his name.
words.example_uz: Men uning ismini aniqlash uchun fayldan foydalandim.

words.definition: An island is land in the middle of water.
words.definition_uz: Orol suv o'rtasidagi quruqlikdir.
words.example: Japan is a group of islands.
words.example_uz: Yaponiya orollar guruhidir.

words.definition: The ocean is all of the salt water that surrounds land.
words.definition_uz: Okean — quruqlikni o'rab turgan barcha sho'r suv.
words.example: The ocean can make powerful waves.
words.example_uz: Okean kuchli to'lqinlar yaratishi mumkin.

words.definition: Perhaps is used when you say that something could happen.
words.definition_uz: Ehtimol, nimadir bo'lishi mumkin deb aytganda ishlatiladi.
words.example: Perhaps I will eat an apple for lunch.
words.example_uz: Ehtimol, tushlikda olma yeyman.

words.definition: If something is pleasant, you enjoy it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yoqimli bo'lsa, undan zavqlaning.
words.example: The character had a pleasant look on its face.
words.example_uz: Qahramon yuzida yoqimli ko'rinish bor edi.

words.definition: To prevent something is to stop it from happening.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani oldini olish — uni to'xtatishdir.
words.example: The handcuffs prevented me from moving my hands.
words.example_uz: Qo'lqoplar qo'llarimni harakatlantirishimga to'sqinlik qildi.

words.definition: A rock is a hard thing in the dirt.
words.definition_uz: Tosh tuproqda qattiq narsa.
words.example: I stacked rocks on top of one another.
words.example_uz: Men toshlarni bir-birining ustiga qo'ydim.

words.definition: To save something is to keep it from being hurt.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir saqlab qolish uni zarar ko'rishdan saqlashdir.
words.example: I want to help save the world.
words.example_uz: Men dunyoni qutqarishga yordam bermoqchiman.

words.definition: To step is to walk.
words.definition_uz: Qadam bosish yurishdir.
words.example: Be careful where you step.
words.example_uz: Qayerga qadam qo'yganingga ehtiyot bo'l.

words.definition: Still is used when you say that a situation keeps going on.
words.definition_uz: Still so'zi vaziyat davom etayotganini aytganda ishlatiladi.
words.example: They are still waiting in line to get tickets.
words.example_uz: Ular hali ham chipta olish uchun navbatda turishmoqda.

words.definition: A taste is the flavor something makes in your mouth.
words.definition_uz: Ta'm — bu og'izda nimadir yaratadigan ta'mdir.
words.example: The taste of the fruit was sweet.
words.example_uz: Mevaning ta'mi shirin edi.

words.definition: To throw something is to use your hand to make it go through the air.
words.definition_uz: Nimani uloqtirish — qo'ling bilan uni havoga o'tkazishdir.
words.example: The pitcher can throw the baseball very fast.
words.example_uz: Pitcher beysbolni juda tez uloqtira oladi.

words.definition: A wave is a line of water that moves higher than the rest of the water.
words.definition_uz: To'lqin — bu suvning qolgan qismidan balandroq harakatlanadigan suv chizig'i.
words.example: The water was filled with large blue waves.
words.example_uz: Suv katta ko'k to'lqinlar bilan to'ldirilgan edi.

words.definition: A benefit is a good thing.
words.definition_uz: Foyda yaxshi narsa.
words.example: Being able to fly is a good benefit to birds.
words.example_uz: Uchish qobiliyati qushlar uchun yaxshi foyda.

words.definition: If you are certain about something, you know it is true.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimagadir ishonchingiz komil bo'lsa, demak bu haqiqat ekanini bilasiz.
words.example: I am certain that zebras have stripes.
words.example_uz: Ishonchim komilki, zebralarda chiziqlar bor.

words.definition: A chance is an opportunity to do something.
words.definition_uz: Imkoniyat nimadir qilish imkoniyatidir.
words.example: I had a chance to see the Roman Coliseum last summer.
words.example_uz: O'tgan yozda Rim Kolizeyini ko'rishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

words.definition: An effect is a change made by something else.
words.definition_uz: Effekt — bu boshqa narsa tomonidan amalga oshirilgan o'zgarish.
words.example: The medicine had a good effect on the boy.
words.example_uz: Dori bolaga yaxshi ta'sir qilgan.

words.definition: If something is essential, it is very important and necessary.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir muhim bo'lsa, u juda muhim va zarur.
words.example: It is essential to have oxygen when you scuba dive.
words.example_uz: Suv ostida sho'ng'ishda kislorod bo'lishi juda muhim.

words.definition: If something is far, it is not close.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir uzoqda bo'lsa, yaqin emas.
words.example: It’s far going from the east coast to the west coast of America.
words.example_uz: Sharqiy qirg'oqdan g'arbiy Amerika sohiligacha.

words.definition: To focus on something is to think about it and pay attention to it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsaga e'tibor qaratish — bu o'ylab ko'rish va unga e'tibor berishdir.
words.example: My mom always helps me to focus on my school work.
words.example_uz: Onam har doim maktab ishlarimga e'tibor qaratishda yordam beradi.

words.definition: The function of something is what it does.
words.definition_uz: Nimadirning vazifasi uning qiladigan ishidir.
words.example: The function of a flashlight is to help you see in the dark.
words.example_uz: Fonarning vazifasi qorong'uda ko'rishga yordam berishdir.

words.definition: Grass is the green leaves that cover the ground.
words.definition_uz: O't — bu yer yuzini qoplaydigan yashil barglar.
words.example: The grass looked so soft and green.
words.example_uz: O't juda yumshoq va yashil ko'rinardi.

words.definition: To guard something is to take care of it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir qo'riqlash — unga g'amxo'rlik qilishdir.
words.example: The police officer will guard us from any harm.
words.example_uz: Politsiya xodimi bizni har qanday xavfdan himoya qiladi.

words.definition: The image of something is a picture of it.
words.definition_uz: Nimadir tasviri uning rasmidir.
words.example: The image of her eye was very clear.
words.example_uz: Ko'zining tasviri juda aniq edi.

words.definition: If something is immediate, it happens quickly.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa zudlik bilan sodir bo'lsa, u tez sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: An immediate response came from the pizza place.
words.example_uz: Pitssa joyidan darhol javob keldi.

words.definition: If something is primary, it is the most important thing.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir asosiy bo'lsa, u eng muhim narsadir.
words.example: His primary thoughts are about money.
words.example_uz: Uning asosiy fikrlari pul haqida.

words.definition: If someone feels proud, they are happy about what they have done.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir o'zini faxrlantirsa, qilgan ishidan xursand bo'ladi.
words.example: She is proud of the picture she drew of her house.
words.example_uz: U o'z uyining rasmini chizganidan faxrlanadi.

words.definition: To remain somewhere is to stay there.
words.definition_uz: Qayerdadir qolish — o'sha yerda qolish.
words.example: My sister had to remain home since she was sick.
words.example_uz: Opam kasal bo'lgani uchun uyda qolishi kerak edi.

words.definition: To rest is to stop being active while the body gets back its strength.
words.definition_uz: Dam olish — tana kuchini tiklaguncha faol bo'lishni to'xtatishdir.
words.example: I rested on the couch after work.
words.example_uz: Ishdan keyin divanda dam olardim.

words.definition: If two things are separate, they are not together.
words.definition_uz: Agar ikki narsa alohida bo'lsa, ular birga emas.
words.example: New York and Los Angeles are in two separate parts of America.
words.example_uz: Nyu-York va Los-Anjeles Amerikaning ikki alohida hududida joylashgan.

words.definition: A site is a place.
words.definition_uz: Sayt — bu joy.
words.example: We found the perfect site for our picnic.
words.example_uz: Piknik uchun mukammal joyni topdik.

words.definition: A tail is a part of an animal’s body, sticking out from its rear or back.
words.definition_uz: Dum — bu hayvon tanasining orqa yoki orqa qismidan chiqib turadigan qismi.
words.example: Our dog wags its tail when it’s happy.
words.example_uz: Bizning itimiz baxtli bo'lsa, dumini silkitadi.

words.definition: Trouble is a problem ora difficulty.
words.definition_uz: Muammo muammo yoki qiyinchilik.
words.example: I have trouble working with my boss.
words.example_uz: Boshlig'im bilan ishlashda qiynalaman.

words.definition: Anymore means any longer.
words.definition_uz: Ko'proq degani.
words.example: Her old pants don’t fit her anymore.
words.example_uz: Uning eski shimlari endi unga mos kelmaydi.

words.definition: When a person is asleep, they are not awake.
words.definition_uz: Odam uxlayotgan bo'lsa, u uyg'oq emas.
words.example: The baby has been asleep for hours.
words.example_uz: Bola soatlab uxlab yotibdi.

words.definition: A berry is a small round fruit that grows on certain plants and trees.
words.definition_uz: Meva — bu ma'lum o'simliklar va daraxtlarda o'sadigan kichik dumaloq meva.
words.example: The berry looked delicious.
words.example_uz: Mevalar juda mazali ko'rinardi.

words.definition: To collect things is to group them together all in one place.
words.definition_uz: Narsalarni to'plash — ularni bir joyga to'plashdir.
words.example: I collected shells when I was younger.
words.example_uz: Men yoshligimda qobiq yig'ardim.

words.definition: To compete is to try to be better than someone.
words.definition_uz: Raqobatlashish — kimdandir yaxshiroq bo'lishga harakat qilishdir.
words.example: He will compete with very good athletes.
words.example_uz: U juda yaxshi sportchilar bilan bellashadi.

words.definition: A conversation is a talk between people.
words.definition_uz: Suhbat — bu odamlar o'rtasidagi suhbat.
words.example: There were two conversations going on at once.
words.example_uz: Bir vaqtning o'zida ikki suhbat bo'lib o'tdi.

words.definition: A creature is any living thing.
words.definition_uz: Mavjudot har qanday tirik mavjudotdir.
words.example: The creature we saw today was either a dolphin or a porpoise.
words.example_uz: Bugun ko'rgan maxluq delfin yoki delfin edi.

words.definition: A decision is a choice.
words.definition_uz: Qaror tanlovdir.
words.example: He made the wrong decision.
words.example_uz: U noto'g'ri qaror qildi.

words.definition: Either is used with “or” to say there are two or more possibilities.
words.definition_uz: Ikkala so'z ham "yoki" bilan ishlatiladi, bu ikki yoki undan ortiq imkoniyat borligini anglatadi.
words.example: You can choose to be either white or black when you play chess.
words.example_uz: Shaxmat o'ynaganda oq yoki qora rangni tanlashingiz mumkin.

words.definition: A forest is a place with lots of trees and animals.
words.definition_uz: O'rmon — bu ko'plab daraxtlar va hayvonlar yashaydigan joy.
words.example: I love to go walking in the forest.
words.example_uz: Men o'rmonda sayr qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.

words.definition: The ground is the top part of the Earth that we walk on.
words.definition_uz: Yer — bu biz yuradigan Yerning eng yuqori qismi.
words.example: The ground under our feet was dry and brown.
words.example_uz: Oyoqlarimiz ostidagi yer quruq va jigarrang edi.

words.definition: To introduce someone or something is to say who they are.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir tanishtirish — bu kimligini aytishdir.
words.example: I introduced myself to our newest co-worker today.
words.example_uz: Bugun o'zimni eng yangi hamkasbimizga tanishtirdim.

words.definition: To marry is to legally become husband and wife.
words.definition_uz: Uylanish — bu qonuniy er-xotin bo'lishdir.
words.example: Rose and Henry were married, and they lived happily.
words.example_uz: Rouz va Genri turmush qurishdi va baxtli yashashdi.

words.definition: To prepare is to get ready for something.
words.definition_uz: Tayyorlanish nimagadir tayyorlanishdir.
words.example: I prepared my speech to the class.
words.example_uz: Men sinfga nutqimni tayyorladim.

words.definition: To sail is to move a boat on the water.
words.definition_uz: Suzish — suvda qayiqni harakatlantirishdir.
words.example: I love to sail my boat on the lake.
words.example_uz: Men qayig'imni ko'lda suzishni yaxshi ko'raman.

words.definition: When something is serious, it is bad or unsafe.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa jiddiy bo'lsa, u yomon yoki xavfli emas.
words.example: The accident was very serious.
words.example_uz: Avariya juda jiddiy edi.

words.definition: To spend is to use time doing something or being somewhere.
words.definition_uz: Sarflash — bu vaqtni nimagadir sarflash yoki qayerdadir bo'lishdir.
words.example: I like to spend my free time fishing.
words.example_uz: Bo'sh vaqtimni baliq ovlashga sarflashni yoqtiraman.

words.definition: When something is strange, it is not normal.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir g'alati bo'lsa, bu normal emas.
words.example: Joe had a strange look on his face after he saw what happened.
words.example_uz: Jo nima bo'lganini ko'rgach, yuzida g'alati ifoda paydo bo'ldi.

words.definition: The truth is a fact or something that is right.
words.definition_uz: Haqiqat haqiqat yoki to'g'ri narsadir.
words.example: He was telling the truth about seeing a large green snake.
words.example_uz: U katta yashil ilonni ko'rgani haqida rost gapirayotgan edi.

words.definition: To wake is to not be sleeping anymore.
words.definition_uz: Uyg'onish — endi uxlamaslikdir.
words.example: He is always full of energy when he wakes in the morning.
words.example_uz: U har doim ertalab uyg'onganida energiyaga to'la bo'ladi.

words.definition: If someone is alone, they are not with another person.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yolg'iz bo'lsa, u boshqa odam bilan emas.
words.example: The boy wanted to be alone to think.
words.example_uz: Bola yolg'iz bo'lib, o'ylashni xohlardi.

words.definition: An apartment is a set of rooms in a building where people live.
words.definition_uz: Kvartira — bu odamlar yashaydigan binodagi xonalar to'plamidir.
words.example: She has a nice apartment in the city.
words.example_uz: Uning shaharda yaxshi kvartirasi bor.

words.definition: An article is a story in a newspaper or magazine.
words.definition_uz: Maqola — bu gazeta yoki jurnaldagi hikoya.
words.example: Did you read the article in the newspaper about the soccer game?
words.example_uz: Gazetadagi futbol o'yini haqidagi maqolani o'qidingizmi?

words.definition: An artist is a person who paints, draws, or makes sculptures.
words.definition_uz: Rassom — bu rasm chizadigan, chizadigan yoki haykallar yasaydigan shaxsdir.
words.example: He went to Paris to become an artist.
words.example_uz: U rassom bo'lish uchun Parijga ketgan.

words.definition: Someone’s attitude is the way they feel and think.
words.definition_uz: Kimningdir munosabati ularning his-tuyg'ulari va fikrlari.
words.example: John has a bad attitude. He’s always angry.
words.example_uz: Jonning kayfiyati yomon. U doim jahli chiqadi.

words.definition: To compare means to say how two things are the same and different.
words.definition_uz: Taqqoslash degani, ikki narsa bir xil va farqli ekanini anglatadi.
words.example: If you compare cats and dogs, you’ll see that they’re both good pets.
words.example_uz: Agar mushuklar va itlarni solishtirsangiz, ikkalasi ham yaxshi uy hayvoni ekanini ko'rasiz.

words.definition: To judge something is to say if it is good or bad.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani baholash — bu uning yaxshi yoki yomon ekanini aytishdir.
words.example: The boy was going to judge how his mother’s turkey tasted.
words.example_uz: Bola onasining kurkasining ta'mini baholashi kerak edi.

words.definition: A magazine is a regular publication with news, stories, and articles.
words.definition_uz: Jurnal — yangiliklar, hikoyalar va maqolalarni o'z ichiga olgan muntazam nashr.
words.example: She likes to read fashion magazines.
words.example_uz: U moda jurnallarini o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.

words.definition: A material is what is used to make something.
words.definition_uz: Material — bu nimanidir yaratishda ishlatiladigan narsa.
words.example: Brick is a good material for building houses.
words.example_uz: G'isht uy qurish uchun yaxshi materialdir.

words.definition: A meal is a time when food is eaten like breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
words.definition_uz: Ovqat — nonushta, tushlik yoki kechki ovqat kabi ovqatlar iste'mol qilinadigan vaqt.
words.example: Breakfast is my favorite meal because I enjoy breakfast foods.
words.example_uz: Nonushta mening eng sevimli taomim, chunki nonushta taomlarini yoqtiraman.

words.definition: A method is the way to do something.
words.definition_uz: Usul — bu biror ishni qilish yo'li.
words.example: One method to remember things is to tie a string around your finger.
words.example_uz: Eslab qolishning bir usuli — barmog'ingizga ip bog'lash.

words.definition: A neighbor is a person who lives near you.
words.definition_uz: Qo'shni — bu yaqin atrofda yashovchi odam.
words.example: I like my neighbor because he’s very friendly.
words.example_uz: Qo'shnimni yoqtiraman, chunki u juda do'stona.

words.definition: If something is professional, it deals with work that uses special skills.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa professional bo'lsa, u maxsus ko'nikmalarni talab qiladigan ish bilan shug'ullanadi.
words.example: If you want to be a pilot, you must have professional training.
words.example_uz: Agar uchuvchi bo'lishni istasang, professional tayyorgarlikka ega bo'lishing kerak.

words.definition: A profit is the extra money you make when you sell something.
words.definition_uz: Foyda — bu nimanidir sotganingizda ortiqcha pul topasiz.
words.example: I made a small profit from selling my old clothes.
words.example_uz: Eski kiyimlarimni sotishdan ozgina foyda oldim.

words.definition: The quality of something is how good it is.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsaning sifati uning qanchalik yaxshi ekanligidir.
words.example: The quality of his car is very good.
words.example_uz: Uning mashinasining sifati juda yaxshi.

words.definition: A shape is a simple form like a square or circle.
words.definition_uz: Shakl oddiy shakl bo'lib, masalan, kvadrat yoki doira.
words.example: The triangle is my favorite shape.
words.example_uz: Uchburchak mening eng sevimli shaklim.

words.definition: A space is an empty area.
words.definition_uz: Bo'shliq bo'sh hududdir.
words.example: I don’t have much space for things in my small house.
words.example_uz: Mening kichik uyimda narsalar uchun joy ko'p emas.

words.definition: Stairs are the things that are used to go up in a building.
words.definition_uz: Zinapoyalar binoda yuqoriga ko'tarilish uchun ishlatiladigan narsalar.
words.example: You can take the stairs to the second floor.
words.example_uz: Ikkinchi qavatga zinadan chiqishingiz mumkin.

words.definition: A symbol is a thing that stands for something else.
words.definition_uz: Ramz — bu boshqa narsani anglatadigan narsa.
words.example: This symbol tells us that we cannot smoke in this area.
words.example_uz: Bu ramz bizga bu hududda chekish mumkin emasligini bildiradi.

words.definition: If someone or something is thin, they are not fat.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki nimadir ozg'in bo'lsa, ular semiz emas.
words.example: The man was thin because he didn’t eat much.
words.example_uz: U odam ozg'in edi, chunki ko'p ovqat yemasdi.

words.definition: Blood is the red liquid in your body.
words.definition_uz: Qon tanangizdagi qizil suyuqlikdir.
words.example: I cut my finger and got blood on my shirt.
words.example_uz: Barmog'imni kesib, ko'ylagimga qon chiqdi.

words.definition: To burn something is to set it on fire.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir yoqish uni yoqishdir.
words.example: I burned some wood in the camp fire.
words.example_uz: Men lager olovida yog'och yoqdim.

words.definition: A cell is a small room where a person is locked in.
words.definition_uz: Hujayra — bu odam qulflangan kichik xona.
words.example: The jail cell was very small.
words.example_uz: Qamoqxona xonasi juda kichik edi.

words.definition: To contain something is to have it inside.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir o'z ichiga olish, uni ichida saqlashdir.
words.example: The mailbox contained a letter.
words.example_uz: Pochta qutisida xat bor edi.

words.definition: To be correct is to be right.
words.definition_uz: To'g'ri bo'lish — to'g'ri bo'lishdir.
words.example: All of my answers on the test were correct.
words.example_uz: Testdagi barcha javoblarim to'g'ri edi.

words.definition: A crop is food that a farmer grows.
words.definition_uz: Hosil — bu dehqon yetishtiradigan oziq-ovqatdir.
words.example: Wheat is a crop that is made into bread.
words.example_uz: Bug'doy — non tayyorlanadigan ekin.

words.definition: To demand something is to say strongly that you want it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir talab qilish, uni xohlayotganingni qat'iy aytishdir.
words.example: The workers demanded to be paid more money.
words.example_uz: Ishchilar ko'proq maosh talab qilishdi.

words.definition: To be equal is to be the same.
words.definition_uz: Teng bo'lish bir xil bo'lishdir.
words.example: Both students are equal in age.
words.example_uz: Ikkala o'quvchi ham yosh jihatidan teng.

words.definition: To feed is to give food.
words.definition_uz: Oziqlantirish ovqat berishdir.
words.example: Mother feeds my baby brother everyday.
words.example_uz: Onam har kuni ukamni boqadi.

words.definition: A hole is an opening in something.
words.definition_uz: Teshik nimadadir teshikdir.
words.example: The man was going to jump into the hole in the ice.
words.example_uz: U muzdagi teshikka sakramoqchi edi.

words.definition: To increase something is to make it larger or more.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani oshirish uni kattalashtirish yoki undan ham ko'proq qilish demakdir.
words.example: They’ve increased the price of gas by 15 cents!
words.example_uz: Benzin narxini 15 sentga oshirishdi!

words.definition: Long ago, a lord was a man in charge of a town.
words.definition_uz: Uzoq vaqt oldin, bir lord shaharni boshqaruvchi odam edi.
words.example: The lord of the town was not kind.
words.example_uz: Shahar egasi mehribon emas edi.

words.definition: To owe is to have to pay or give back something received from another.
words.definition_uz: Qarzdor bo'lish boshqasidan olingan narsani to'lash yoki qaytarishdir.
words.example: I owed him twenty dollars, so I paid him back.
words.example_uz: Men unga yigirma dollar qarzdor edim, shuning uchun qaytardim.

words.definition: A position is the way something is placed.
words.definition_uz: Pozitsiya — bu bir narsaning qanday joylashtirilishi.
words.example: How can you sit in that position?
words.example_uz: Qanday qilib bunday holatda o'tira olasan?

words.definition: To raise something is to lift it up.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir ko'tarish — uni ko'tarishdir.
words.example: We had to work together to raise the last piece.
words.example_uz: Oxirgi bo'lakni ko'tarish uchun birga ishlashimiz kerak edi.

words.definition: If a person is responsible, they do the right things.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir javobgar bo'lsa, to'g'ri ish qiladi.
words.example: I try to be responsible and save money.
words.example_uz: Mas'uliyatli bo'lishga va pulni tejashga harakat qilaman.

words.definition: A sight is something interesting to see.
words.definition_uz: Manzara — bu ko'rishga arziydigan narsa.
words.example: I saw the pyramids of Egypt. What a sight!
words.example_uz: Men Misr piramidalarini ko'rdim. Qanday manzara!

words.definition: A spot is a place where something happens.
words.definition_uz: Joy — bu nimadir sodir bo'ladigan joy.
words.example: The kitchen is a good spot to eat meals.
words.example_uz: Oshxona ovqatlanish uchun yaxshi joy.

words.definition: A structure is a building.
words.definition_uz: Tuzilma — bu bino.
words.example: They just built a beautiful new structure downtown.
words.example_uz: Ular yaqinda shaharning markazida chiroyli yangi bino qurishdi.

words.definition: Whole means all of something.
words.definition_uz: Butun degani nimanidir anglatadi.
words.example: I ate the whole pie. We don’t have any more.
words.example_uz: Men butun pirogni yedim. Bizda boshqa yo'q.

words.definition: A coach is a person who teaches sports.
words.definition_uz: Murabbiy sportni o'rgatadigan shaxsdir.
words.example: My coach gets very excited during games.
words.example_uz: Murabbiyim o'yinlar paytida juda hayajonlanadi.

words.definition: To control something is to make it do what you want.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir nazorat qilish — uni xohlaganingni qilishga majbur qilishdir.
words.example: To control the TV, just push the buttons.
words.example_uz: Televizorni boshqarish uchun shunchaki tugmalarni bosing.

words.definition: A description of someone or something says what they are like.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir tasvirlash ularning qanday ekanligini ko'rsatadi.
words.example: I gave a description of the man with the gun and hat to the police.
words.example_uz: Men politsiyaga qurol va shlyapali odamning tavsifini berdim.

words.definition: If something is direct, it goes straight between two places.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bo'lsa, u ikki joydan to'g'ri o'tadi.
words.example: The green path is a direct route to my house.
words.example_uz: Yashil yo'l mening uyimga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yo'l.

words.definition: An exam is a test.
words.definition_uz: Imtihon - bu imtihon.
words.example: I did some practice questions for the math exam on the board.
words.example_uz: Men matematika imtihoni uchun taxtada bir nechta amaliy savollar berdim.

words.definition: An example of something is a thing that is typical of it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsaning misoli — bu unga xos bo'lgan narsadir.
words.example: Cola is an example of a soft drink.
words.example_uz: Kola gazli ichimlikka misol bo'la oladi.

words.definition: A limit is the largest or smallest amount of something that you allow.
words.definition_uz: Limit — bu ruxsat berilgan eng katta yoki eng kichik miqdor.
words.example: My mother put a limit on how much I could use the phone.
words.example_uz: Onam telefonni qancha ishlatishimga cheklov qo'ygan.

words.definition: If something is local, it is nearby.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir mahalliy bo'lsa, u yaqin atrofda.
words.example: The local market in my neighborhood sells all the food we need.
words.example_uz: Mening mahallamdagi mahalliy bozorda kerakli barcha oziq-ovqat sotiladi.

words.definition: Magical describes a quality that makes someone or something special.
words.definition_uz: Sehrli deganda kimdir yoki nimanidir maxsus qiladigan sifat ifodalanadi.
words.example: The fireworks made the night sky look so magical.
words.example_uz: Mushaklar tungi osmonni juda sehrli qilib ko'rsatdi.

words.definition: Mail is letters and other things sent to people.
words.definition_uz: Pochta — bu odamlar uchun yuboriladigan xatlar va boshqa narsalar.
words.example: I get a lot of mail because I have friends all over the world.
words.example_uz: Men ko'p pochta olaman, chunki butun dunyoda do'stlarim bor.

words.definition: A novel is a book that tells a story.
words.definition_uz: Roman — bu hikoya aytadigan kitobdir.
words.example: He wrote a great novel about ancient China.
words.example_uz: U qadimgi Xitoy haqida ajoyib roman yozgan.

words.definition: An outline is the plan for a story or essay.
words.definition_uz: Dastur — bu hikoya yoki insho uchun reja.
words.example: Before I wrote my essay, I made an outline.
words.example_uz: Insho yozishdan oldin, men reja tuzdim.

words.definition: A poet is a person who writes poems.
words.definition_uz: Shoir — she'r yozadigan inson.
words.example: William Shakespeare was one of the greatest poets.
words.example_uz: Uilyam Shekspir eng buyuk shoirlardan biri edi.

words.definition: To print something is to put it onto paper.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani chop etish — uni qog'ozga yozishdir.
words.example: Make sure that you print your name clearly.
words.example_uz: Ismingizni aniq chop etishingizga ishonch hosil qiling.

words.definition: A scene is one part of a book or movie.
words.definition_uz: Sahna kitob yoki filmning bir qismidir.
words.example: A movie is made up of many short pieces or scenes.
words.example_uz: Film ko'plab qisqa qismlar yoki sahnalardan iborat.

words.definition: A sheet is a thin flat piece of paper.
words.definition_uz: Varaq — bu ingichka, tekis qog'oz bo'lagi.
words.example: I only needed a single sheet of paper to do my homework.
words.example_uz: Uy vazifamni qilish uchun faqat bitta varaq qog'oz kerak edi.

words.definition: If someone or something is silly, they show a lack of thought.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki nimadir bo'lsa, ular o'ylamaslikni ko'rsatadi.
words.example: I made a silly mistake of dropping mom’s vase.
words.example_uz: Men onamning vazasini tushirib yuborib, ahmoqona xato qildim.

words.definition: A store is a place where you can buy things.
words.definition_uz: Do'kon — bu narsalarni sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan joy.
words.example: I picked up a few things at the grocery store.
words.example_uz: Do'kondan bir nechta narsalarni oldim.

words.definition: To suffer is to feel pain.
words.definition_uz: Azob chekish og'riqni his qilishdir.
words.example: Her headache made her suffer all day.
words.example_uz: Bosh og'rig'i uni kun bo'yi azoblardi.

words.definition: Technology is new things made by using science.
words.definition_uz: Texnologiya ilm-fan yordamida yaratilgan yangi narsalardir.
words.example: He loves technology such as laptop computers.
words.example_uz: U noutbuk kabi texnologiyalarni yaxshi ko'radi.

words.definition: To go across something is to go to the other side of it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsadan o'tish, uning boshqa tomoniga borishdir.
words.example: He walked across the board to the other side.
words.example_uz: U doskadan o'tib, boshqa tomonga o'tdi.

words.definition: To breathe means to let air go in and out of your body.
words.definition_uz: Nafas olish — havoni tanangga kirib-chiqishga ruxsat berish degani.
words.example: We need strong healthy lungs to help us breathe well.
words.example_uz: Bizga yaxshi nafas olish uchun kuchli va sog'lom o'pka kerak.

words.definition: A characteristic is something that shows what a person or a thing is like.
words.definition_uz: Xususiyat — bu inson yoki narsaning qanday ekanligini ko'rsatadigan narsadir.
words.example: One characteristic of tigers is their black stripes.
words.example_uz: Yo'lbarslarning bir xususiyati — ularning qora chiziqlari.

words.definition: To consume something means to eat or drink it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir iste'mol qilish uni yeyish yoki ichish degani.
words.example: Jack consumed a whole plate of spaghetti.
words.example_uz: Jack butun bir likopcha spagetti yeb qo'ydi.

words.definition: To excite someone means to make them happy and interested.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir hayajonlantirish uni baxtli va qiziqtirish degani.
words.example: I heard about the school dance on Friday. This excited me.
words.example_uz: Juma kuni maktab raqsi haqida eshitdim. Bu meni hayajonga soldi.

words.definition: If something is extreme, it is in a large amount or degree.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir ekstremal bo'lsa, u katta miqdorda yoki darajada bo'ladi.
words.example: His workout was so extreme that he was sweating heavily.
words.example_uz: Uning mashg'ulotlari shunchalik kuchli ediki, u juda ko'p terladi.

words.definition: Fear is the feeling of being afraid.
words.definition_uz: Qo'rquv — bu qo'rqish tuyg'usi.
words.example: I have a great fear of skateboarding.
words.example_uz: Men skeytborddan juda qo'rqaman.

words.definition: If you are fortunate, you are lucky.
words.definition_uz: Agar omadli bo'lsang, omadlisan.
words.example: I was fortunate to get a seat.
words.example_uz: Menga o'rindiq olish baxtli bo'ldi.

words.definition: If someone happens to do something, they do it by chance.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir nimadir qilsa, tasodifan qiladi.
words.example: I happened to meet some new friends at school today.
words.example_uz: Bugun maktabda yangi do'stlar bilan tanishdim.

words.definition: The length of something is how long it is from one end to the other.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsaning uzunligi uning bir uchidan ikkinchisigacha bo'lgan uzunligidir.
words.example: The length of the floor is three meters.
words.example_uz: Polning uzunligi uch metr.

words.definition: A mistake is something you do wrong.
words.definition_uz: Xato — bu noto'g'ri ish.
words.example: My boss always yells at me when I make a mistake.
words.example_uz: Mening boshlig'im xato qilganimda doim menga baqiradi.

words.definition: To observe something is to watch it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir kuzatish — uni kuzatishdir.
words.example: Brian observed the sun rising over the mountains.
words.example_uz: Brian tog'lar ustida quyosh chiqishini kuzatdi.

words.definition: An opportunity is a chance to do something.
words.definition_uz: Imkoniyat nimanidir qilish imkoniyatidir.
words.example: I had an opportunity to take pictures in the jungle.
words.example_uz: Men o'rmonda suratga tushish imkoniga ega bo'ldim.

words.definition: A prize is something of value that is given to the winner.
words.definition_uz: Mukofot — bu g'olibga beriladigan qimmatli narsa.
words.example: I won a prize for getting the best grade on my science test.
words.example_uz: Men fan imtihonimda eng yaxshi baho olganim uchun mukofot yutdim.
