words.definition: A race is a contest to see who is the fastest.
words.definition_uz: Poyga — bu kim eng tez kelishini aniqlash uchun o'tkaziladigan musobaqadir.
words.example: Paul is a fast runner, so he easily won the race.
words.example_uz: Pol tez yuguradi, shuning uchun poygani osonlik bilan yutdi.

words.definition: To realize is to suddenly understand.
words.definition_uz: Tushunish — birdan tushunishdir.
words.example: After I left my house, I realized that I left the light on.
words.example_uz: Uyimdan chiqqach, chiroqni yoqib qo'yganimni angladim.

words.definition: To respond is to give an answer to what someone else said.
words.definition_uz: Javob berish — boshqalar aytganiga javob berishdir.
words.example: When the teacher asked the question, we all responded.
words.example_uz: O'qituvchi savol berganda, hammamiz javob berdik.

words.definition: A risk is a chance of something bad happening.
words.definition_uz: Xavf - bu yomon narsa yuz berishi ehtimoli.
words.example: I took a risk and climbed the snowy mountain.
words.example_uz: Men xavfga borib, qorli tog'ga chiqdim.

words.definition: To wonder is to ask yourself questions or have a need to know.
words.definition_uz: O'ylash — o'zingizga savol berish yoki bilishga ehtiyoj sezishdir.
words.example: The young mother wondered if she’d have a boy or a girl.
words.example_uz: Yosh ona o'g'ilmi yoki qizmi deb o'ylagan.

words.definition: Yet is used to say something has not happened up to now.
words.definition_uz: Lekin hozirgacha biror narsa bo'lmagan deb aytish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example: We can’t go out yet; we’re still eating.
words.example_uz: Hali chiqolmaymiz; Hali ham ovqatlanyapmiz.

words.definition: An academy is a special type of school.
words.definition_uz: Akademiya maxsus turdagi maktabdir.
words.example: There are many courses taught at the academy that I go to.
words.example_uz: Men qatnashadigan akademiyada ko'plab kurslar o'qitiladi.

words.definition: If something is ancient, it is very old.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir qadimiy bo'lsa, u juda qadimiy.
words.example: I want to see the ancient buildings in Rome.
words.example_uz: Men Rimdagi qadimiy binolarni ko'rmoqchiman.

words.definition: A board is a flat piece of wood.
words.definition_uz: Taxta — bu tekis yog'och bo'lagi.
words.example: The sign was made of a few wooden boards.
words.example_uz: Belgi bir nechta yog'och taxtalardan yasalgan edi.

words.definition: A century is one hundred years.
words.definition_uz: Asr yuz yil.
words.example: Our company is celebrating a century of business in London.
words.example_uz: Bizning kompaniyamiz Londonda bir asrlik faoliyatini nishonlamoqda.

words.definition: A clue is a fact or object that helps solve a mystery or crime.
words.definition_uz: Ishora — bu sir yoki jinoyatni hal qilishga yordam beradigan fakt yoki ob'ekt.
words.example: The detective found some clues on the sidewalk.
words.example_uz: Detektiv trotuarda ba'zi dalillar topdi.

words.definition: A concert is an event where you listen to people play music.
words.definition_uz: Konsert — bu musiqa ijro etayotgan odamlarni tinglaydigan tadbir.
words.example: I enjoyed the concert last night. The band was very good.
words.example_uz: Kecha konsertdan zavq oldim. Guruh juda yaxshi edi.

words.definition: A county is the largest political division of a state in the US.
words.definition_uz: Okrug AQShdagi shtatning eng yirik siyosiy bo'linmasidir.
words.example: He wanted to represent the citizens of his county.
words.example_uz: U o'z okrugi fuqarolarini vakillik qilishni xohlardi.

words.definition: A dictionary is a book that tells you what words mean.
words.definition_uz: Lug'at — bu so'zlarning ma'nosini aytadigan kitob.
words.example: I use the dictionary to learn new words.
words.example_uz: Yangi so'zlarni o'rganish uchun lug'atdan foydalanaman.

words.definition: To exist is to be real.
words.definition_uz: Mavjud bo'lish — bu haqiqiy bo'lishdir.
words.example: Do you really think that unicorns ever existed?
words.example_uz: Siz haqiqatan ham unicornlar mavjud bo'lgan deb o'ylaysizmi?

words.definition: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts.
words.definition_uz: Flat, egri qismlarsiz, tekis va silliq bo'lgan narsani ifodalaydi.
words.example: My parents bought a new flat screen TV over the weekend.
words.example_uz: Ota-onam dam olish kunlari yangi tekis ekranli televizor sotib olishdi.

words.definition: A gentleman is a nice man.
words.definition_uz: Janob yaxshi odam.
words.example: My grandfather is a kind and helpful gentleman.
words.example_uz: Bobom mehribon va yordamchi janob.

words.definition: Hidden means to be not easily noticed or too hard to find.
words.definition_uz: Yashirin degani oson sezilmaslik yoki topish qiyin bo'lishi degani.
words.example: The hidden camera recorded everything in the parking lot.
words.example_uz: Yashirin kamera avtoturargohdagi hamma narsani yozib olgan.

words.definition: Maybe is used to show that something is possible or may be true.
words.definition_uz: Maybe nimadir mumkinligini yoki haqiqat bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example: If I focus hard enough, maybe I can come up with the right answer.
words.example_uz: Agar yetarlicha diqqat qilsam, balki to'g'ri javobni topa olaman.

words.definition: An officer is a leader in the army.
words.definition_uz: Ofitser armiyada yetakchidir.
words.example: The soldiers followed the orders of the officer.
words.example_uz: Askarlar ofitserning buyruqlariga bo'ysundilar.

words.definition: If something is original, it is the first one of that thing.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir original bo'lsa, u o'sha narsaning birinchisi.
words.example: This is the original painting of the Mona Lisa.
words.example_uz: Bu Mona Lizaning asl rasmi hisoblanadi.

words.definition: To pound something is to hit it many times with a lot of force.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir urish — uni ko'p marta kuchli urishdir.
words.example: He pounded the nail with the hammer.
words.example_uz: U mixni bolg'a bilan urdi.

words.definition: A process is the steps to take to do something.
words.definition_uz: Jarayon — bu nimanidir qilish uchun bajariladigan qadamlar.
words.example: Making a cake is a long process.
words.example_uz: Tort tayyorlash uzoq jarayon.

words.definition: To publish a book is to get it printed and ready to sell.
words.definition_uz: Kitob nashr qilish — uni chop etib, sotishga tayyor qilishdir.
words.example: That company publishes daily newspapers.
words.example_uz: Ushbu kompaniya kundalik gazetalarni nashr etadi.

words.definition: A theater is a building where you watch plays, shows, and movies.
words.definition_uz: Teatr — bu spektakllar, spektakllar va filmlarni tomosha qiladigan bino.
words.example: We went to the theater to see a play.
words.example_uz: Biz teatrga spektaklga bordik.

words.definition: Wealth is a large amount of money.
words.definition_uz: Boylik katta miqdordagi puldir.
words.example: One of the most important things to some people is wealth.
words.example_uz: Ba'zi odamlar uchun eng muhim narsalardan biri boylikdir.

words.definition: To appreciate something is to understand its good qualities.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani qadrlash uning yaxshi fazilatlarini tushunishdir.
words.example: I can appreciate the lovely scenery.
words.example_uz: Go'zal manzarani qadrlay olaman.

words.definition: If something is available, it means you can get it.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa mavjud bo'lsa, demak uni olishingiz mumkin.
words.example: There were many seats available in the room.
words.example_uz: Xonada ko'plab o'rindiqlar mavjud edi.

words.definition: To beat someone means to do better than they do.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir mag'lub etish undan yaxshiroq bo'lishdir.
words.example: I managed to beat everyone in the race.
words.example_uz: Men poygada hammani ortda qoldirdim.

words.definition: If something is bright, it shows a lot of light.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yorqin bo'lsa, u ko'p yorug'likni ko'rsatadi.
words.example: The bright light from the explosion hurt my eyes.
words.example_uz: Portlashdan chiqqan yorqin nur ko'zlarimga og'riq berdi.

words.definition: To celebrate is to do something to show that an event is special.
words.definition_uz: Bayram qilish — bu tadbir o'ziga xos ekanini ko'rsatish uchun nimadir qilishdir.
words.example: We all celebrated when we heard the great news.
words.example_uz: Barchamiz ajoyib xabarni eshitganimizda nishonladik.

words.definition: To determine means to choose or make a decision.
words.definition_uz: Aniqlash — tanlash yoki qaror qabul qilish degani.
words.example: He tried to determine which one to eat first.
words.example_uz: U qaysi birini birinchi yeyishni aniqlashga harakat qildi.

words.definition: To disappear means to go away or not be seen.
words.definition_uz: G'oyib bo'lish — bu ketish yoki ko'rinmaslik.
words.example: The top of the building is disappearing in the clouds.
words.example_uz: Binoning yuqori qismi bulutlar orasida yo'qolib ketmoqda.

words.definition: If you talk about something else, you talk about something different.
words.definition_uz: Agar boshqa narsa haqida gapirsang, boshqa narsani gapirasan.
words.example: I wanted a bike for my birthday, but I got something else.
words.example_uz: Tug'ilgan kunimga velosiped xohlagandim, lekin boshqa narsa oldim.

words.definition: Fair describes treating someone in a way that is reasonable or right.
words.definition_uz: Fair kimnidir oqilona yoki to'g'ri muomala qilishni ta'riflaydi.
words.example: He sold me his car for a fair price.
words.example_uz: U menga mashinasini adolatli narxda sotdi.

words.definition: To flow is to move easily and continuously in one direction.
words.definition_uz: Oqish — bu bir yo'nalishda oson va uzluksiz harakatlanishdir.
words.example: The water flowed over the rocks and into the lake.
words.example_uz: Suv toshlar ustidan oqib ko'lga kirgan.

words.definition: If you move forward, you move in the direction in front of you.
words.definition_uz: Agar oldinga harakat qilsang, oldingdagi yo'nalishda harakat qilasan.
words.example: When he saw his mother, the baby crawled forward to her.
words.example_uz: U onasini ko'rgach, chaqaloq unga yaqinlashdi.

words.definition: A hill is a round area of land. It is higher than the land around it.
words.definition_uz: Tepalik — bu dumaloq yer maydoni. U atrofidagi yerdan balandroq.
words.example: The sun was rising above the green hills.
words.example_uz: Quyosh yashil tepaliklar ustida ko'tarilayotgan edi.

words.definition: A level is a point on a scale that measures something.
words.definition_uz: Daraja — bu nimanidir o'lchaydigan shkaladagi nuqta.
words.example: Please check the level of the temperature.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, harorat darajasini tekshiring.

words.definition: If someone or something is lone, they are the only one of that kind.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki nimadir yolg'iz bo'lsa, ular shunday yagona odam.
words.example: A lone man walked along the street.
words.example_uz: Yolg'iz odam ko'chada yurardi.

words.definition: A puddle is a pool of liquid on the ground.
words.definition_uz: Suv ko'lmaklari yerda to'la suyuqlik havzasidir.
words.example: When the ice melted, it formed a puddle.
words.example_uz: Muz eriganda, u hovuz hosil qilgan.

words.definition: A response is the answer to a question.
words.definition_uz: Javob — bu savolga javob.
words.example: He asked if I was sad. My response was “No.”
words.example_uz: U meni xafa deb so'radi. Mening javobim "Yo'q" edi.

words.definition: A season is a time of the year: spring, summer, fall or winter.
words.definition_uz: Mavsum — bu yilning bir vaqti: bahor, yoz, kuz yoki qish.
words.example: Fall is a warm season, while winter is very cold.
words.example_uz: Kuz issiq fasl, qish esa juda sovuq.

words.definition: A solution is a way to solve a problem.
words.definition_uz: Yechim — bu muammoni hal qilish usuli.
words.example: There are many problems. We need solutions!
words.example_uz: Ko'plab muammolar bor. Bizga yechimlar kerak!

words.definition: To waste means to carelessly use something all up.
words.definition_uz: Behuda sarflash — hammasini beparvo sarflash degani.
words.example: Turn off the water so you don’t waste it.
words.example_uz: Suvni o'chir, behuda sarflamang.

words.definition: You use whether when you must choose between two things.
words.definition_uz: Ikki narsadan birini tanlash kerak bo'lganda siz buni ishlatasiz.
words.example: I could not decide whether to go left or right.
words.example_uz: Chapga yoki o'ngga borishni hal qila olmadim.

words.definition: To argue is to angrily speak to someone because you do not agree.
words.definition_uz: Bahslashish — bu kimnidir g'azab bilan gapirish, chunki sen rozi emassan.
words.example: We argued about where to go for dinner.
words.example_uz: Biz kechki ovqatga qayerga borishni muhokama qildik.

words.definition: To communicate is to give information by talking, writing, etc.
words.definition_uz: Muloqot qilish — bu gapirish, yozish va hokazo orqali ma'lumot berishdir.
words.example: I communicated with Paul about his new ideas.
words.example_uz: Men Pol bilan uning yangi g'oyalari haqida gaplashdim.

words.definition: A crowd is a large group of people.
words.definition_uz: Olomon — bu katta odamlar guruhi.
words.example: A large crowd had gathered on the street to see the accident.
words.example_uz: Katta odamlar ko'chada avariyani ko'rish uchun to'plandi.

words.definition: To depend on someone or something is to need them.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki nimagadir tayanish — ularga ehtiyoj sezishdir.
words.example: Children depend on their parents for many things.
words.example_uz: Bolalar ko'p narsalarda ota-onalariga tayanadi.

words.definition: A dish is a plate.
words.definition_uz: Taom - bu likopcha.
words.example: She put a clean white dish on the table.
words.example_uz: U stolga toza oq idish qo'ydi.

words.definition: If something is empty, it does not have anything in it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir bo'sh bo'lsa, unda hech narsa yo'q.
words.example: My gas tank was almost empty, so I couldn’t drive my car very long.
words.example_uz: Benzin bakim deyarli bo'sh edi, shuning uchun mashinamni uzoq hayday olmadim.

words.definition: If something is exact, it is just the right amount.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa aniq bo'lsa, aynan kerakli miqdorda.
words.example: Please use the exact amount of sugar for the cake.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, tort uchun aniq miqdorda shakar ishlating.

words.definition: If something is fresh, it is new.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yangi bo'lsa, u yangi.
words.example: I just bought these oranges. They are very fresh.
words.example_uz: Men bu apelsinlarni endi sotib oldim. Ular juda yangi.

words.definition: To gather is to collect several things usually from different places.
words.definition_uz: Yig'ish odatda turli joylardan bir nechta narsalarni yig'ishdir.
words.example: Sam gathered some flowers for his mother.
words.example_uz: Sam onasi uchun gullar yig'di.

words.definition: To indicate means to show, point or make something clear.
words.definition_uz: Ko'rsatish degani ko'rsatish, ko'rsatish yoki biror narsani aniqlashtirish degani.
words.example: He pointed to his eyes to indicate where he had hurt himself.
words.example_uz: U o'zini qayerdan jarohatlaganini ko'rsatish uchun ko'zlariga ishora qildi.

words.definition: An item is a thing that you buy or sell.
words.definition_uz: Mahsulot — bu sotib olinadigan yoki sotiladigan narsadir.
words.example: I have many items for school in my bag.
words.example_uz: Sumkamda maktab uchun ko'p narsalar bor.

words.definition: To offer is to present someone with something.
words.definition_uz: Taklif qilish kimgadir nimanidir taqdim etishdir.
words.example: He offered me the keys to his car.
words.example_uz: U menga mashinasining kalitlarini taklif qildi.

words.definition: The price of something is how much it costs.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsaning narxi uning narxiga bog'liq.
words.example: What is the price of this item?
words.example_uz: Bu buyumning narxi qancha?

words.definition: A product is something that is made.
words.definition_uz: Mahsulot — bu yaratiladigan narsa.
words.example: My sister has many beauty products in her room.
words.example_uz: Opamning xonasida ko'plab go'zallik mahsulotlari bor.

words.definition: Property is something that someone owns.
words.definition_uz: Mulk — bu kimdir egalik qiladigan narsa.
words.example: The house is now my property.
words.example_uz: Uy endi mening mulkim.

words.definition: To purchase something is to buy it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir sotib olish uni sotib olishdir.
words.example: I recently purchased a new car.
words.example_uz: Yaqinda yangi mashina sotib oldim.

words.definition: To recommend something is to say that someone should do it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir tavsiya qilish, kimdir uni qilishi kerakligini aytishdir.
words.example: My doctor recommended that I get some exercise.
words.example_uz: Shifokorim menga jismoniy mashq qilishni tavsiya qildi.

words.definition: To select something is to choose it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir tanlash — uni tanlashdir.
words.example: I hope that I selected the right answers on the test.
words.example_uz: Umid qilamanki, testda to'g'ri javoblarni tanladim.

words.definition: A tool is something that helps you do a task.
words.definition_uz: Asbob — bu vazifani bajarishga yordam beradigan narsa.
words.example: We used a tool to fix the window.
words.example_uz: Biz oynani tuzatish uchun asbob ishlatdik.

words.definition: To treat is to act in a certain way toward someone.
words.definition_uz: Davolash — kimnidir muayyan tarzda muomala qilishdir.
words.example: The cats treated the mouse very nicely.
words.example_uz: Mushuklar sichqonni juda yaxshi muomala qilishdi.

words.definition: If someone or something is alive, they are not dead.
words.definition_uz: Agar kimdir yoki nimadir tirik bo'lsa, ular o'lgan emas.
words.example: My grandparents are still alive even though they are over 90.
words.example_uz: Bobom va buvim 90 yoshdan oshgan bo'lsa ham, hali tirik.

words.definition: A bone is a hard part of the body.
words.definition_uz: Suyak tananing qattiq qismidir.
words.example: I brought home a nice bone for my dog.
words.example_uz: Itim uchun chiroyli suyak olib keldim.

words.definition: To bother is to make the effort to do something.
words.definition_uz: Bezovta qilish — biror ish qilishga harakat qilishdir.
words.example: No one bothered to wash the dishes today.
words.example_uz: Bugun hech kim idishlarni yuvmadi.

words.definition: A captain is the person who leads a ship or airplane.
words.definition_uz: Kapitan — bu kemani yoki samolyotni boshqaradigan shaxs.
words.example: The captain sailed his ship to Australia.
words.example_uz: Kapitan o'z kemasini Avstraliyaga suzib bordi.

words.definition: The conclusion of something is the final part of it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaning yakuni uning oxirgi qismidir.
words.example: At the conclusion of the race, the spectators cheered for the winner.
words.example_uz: Poyga yakunida tomoshabinlar g'olibni qo'llab-quvvatlashdi.

words.definition: Doubt is a feeling of not being sure.
words.definition_uz: Shubha — bu ishonchsizlik hissi.
words.example: I have doubt that the story is true.
words.example_uz: Men bu hikoyaning rost ekanligiga shubham bor.

words.definition: To explore is to look for new places.
words.definition_uz: O'rganish yangi joylarni izlashdir.
words.example: He wants to explore the world and see new things.
words.example_uz: U dunyoni o'rganishni va yangi narsalarni ko'rishni xohlaydi.

words.definition: If something is foreign, it is from a different country.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir xorijiy bo'lsa, u boshqa mamlakatdan.
words.example: Mexican food is a popular foreign food.
words.example_uz: Meksika taomlari mashhur xorijiy taomdir.

words.definition: If you are glad, you are happy.
words.definition_uz: Agar xursand bo'lsang, baxtlisan.
words.example: I am glad you came to my party.
words.example_uz: Mening ziyofatimga kelganingdan xursandman.

words.definition: However means despite or not being influenced by something.
words.definition_uz: Biroq, nimadandir ta'sirlangan yoki ta'sirlanmagan degani.
words.example: She is a great cook. However, she never had professional lessons.
words.example_uz: U ajoyib oshpaz. Biroq, u hech qachon professional darslar olmagan.

words.definition: Injustice is a lack of fairness or justice.
words.definition_uz: Adolatsizlik adolatsizlik yoki adolatsizlikdir.
words.example: Putting an innocent person in jail is an act of injustice.
words.example_uz: Aybsiz odamni qamoqqa tashlash adolatsizlikdir.

words.definition: If something is international, it involves more than one country.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa xalqaro bo'lsa, u bir nechta davlatlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
words.example: The United Nations is a powerful international organization.
words.example_uz: Birlashgan Millatlar Tashkiloti kuchli xalqaro tashkilotdir.

words.definition: A lawyer works with the law and represents people in court.
words.definition_uz: Advokat qonun bilan ishlaydi va sudda odamlarni himoya qiladi.
words.example: The lawyer left the courthouse after the judge made her decision.
words.example_uz: Advokat sudya qarorini qabul qilgach, sud binosidan chiqib ketdi.

words.definition: To mention something is to talk about it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani aytish — bu haqda gapirishdir.
words.example: The doctors mentioned the problems that the patient was having.
words.example_uz: Shifokorlar bemorning muammolarini aytib o'tishdi.

words.definition: A policy is a rule.
words.definition_uz: Siyosat qoidadir.
words.example: He told us that his policy was to put customers first.
words.example_uz: U bizga o'z siyosati mijozlarni birinchi o'ringa qo'yish ekanini aytdi.

words.definition: If something is social, it is about many people in a community.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa ijtimoiy bo'lsa, u jamiyatdagi ko'plab odamlar haqida.
words.example: People should come together and fix the world’s social problems.
words.example_uz: Odamlar birlashib, dunyoning ijtimoiy muammolarini hal qilishlari kerak.

words.definition: A speech is something said to a group of people.
words.definition_uz: Nutq — bu bir guruh odamlar oldida aytilgan gap.
words.example: She gave a speech to the class.
words.example_uz: U sinfga nutq so'zladi.

words.definition: A staff is a group of people working together in a company.
words.definition_uz: Xodim — bu kompaniyada birga ishlaydigan odamlar guruhi.
words.example: My dad has a staff of four people to help him at the office.
words.example_uz: Otamga ofisda yordam beradigan to'rt kishilik xodim bor.

words.definition: If you go toward something, you go closer to it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimagadir borsang, unga yaqinlashasan.
words.example: Santa walked toward my house with a special tree.
words.example_uz: Santa maxsus daraxt bilan uyimga qarab yurdi.

words.definition: Wood is the thing that trees are made of.
words.definition_uz: Yog'och — daraxtlar uchun yaratilgan narsa.
words.example: I put the pieces of wood in a pile.
words.example_uz: Men yog'och bo'laklarini bir to'plam qilib qo'ydim.

words.definition: To achieve something is to successfully do it after trying hard.
words.definition_uz: Nimagadir erishish — uni ko'p harakat qilib muvaffaqiyatli bajarishdir.
words.example: I was happy that I could achieve my goal.
words.example_uz: Maqsadimga erisha olganimdan xursand edim.

words.definition: To advise someone is to tell them what to do.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir maslahat berish — ularga nima qilishni aytishdir.
words.example: My mother often advises people about their money.
words.example_uz: Onam ko'pincha odamlarning pullari haqida maslahat beradi.

words.definition: If something happens already, it happens before a certain time.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir allaqachon sodir bo'lsa, u ma'lum vaqtdan oldin sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: It is already time for the movie to start. Let’s go in.
words.example_uz: Film boshlanishi vaqti allaqachon keldi. Keling, ichkariga kiraylik.

words.definition: If something is basic, it is very simple or easy.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa oddiy bo'lsa, juda oddiy yoki oson bo'ladi.
words.example: I learned some basic English skills in school today.
words.example_uz: Bugun maktabda ba'zi asosiy ingliz tilini o'rgandim.

words.definition: A bit is a small amount of something.
words.definition_uz: Bir oz narsa kichik miqdor.
words.example: I ate a bit of chocolate before I went to bed.
words.example_uz: Yotishdan oldin biroz shokolad yedim.

words.definition: To consider something means to think about it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani o'ylash — o'ylash degani.
words.example: Pete didn’t like his job. He considered getting a new one.
words.example_uz: Pit ishini yoqtirmasdi. U yangi mashina olishni o'ylagan.

words.definition: To destroy means to damage something so badly that it cannot be used.
words.definition_uz: Yo'q qilish degani nimanidir shunchalik jiddiy shikastlaydiki, uni ishlatib bo'lmaydi.
words.example: The glass was destroyed.
words.example_uz: Shisha buzildi.

words.definition: To entertain someone is to do something that they enjoy.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir ko'ngil ochish — bu ularga yoqadigan ishni qilishdir.
words.example: The clown entertained the kids at the party.
words.example_uz: Kloun partiyada bolalarni ko'ngil ochdi.

words.definition: If something is extra, it is more than what is needed.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir ortiqcha bo'lsa, u keraklidan ko'proq.
words.example: The squirrel had extra nuts for the winter.
words.example_uz: Squirrel qish uchun qo'shimcha yong'oqlarga ega edi.

words.definition: A goal is something you work toward.
words.definition_uz: Maqsad — bu siz harakat qiladigan narsadir.
words.example: Her goal was to become a doctor.
words.example_uz: Uning maqsadi shifokor bo'lish edi.

words.definition: To lie is to say or write something untrue to deceive someone.
words.definition_uz: Yolg'on gapirish — kimnidir aldash uchun yolg'on gapirish yoki yozishdir.
words.example: Whenever Pinocchio lied to his father, his nose grew.
words.example_uz: Pinokkio otasiga yolg'on gapirganda, uning burni kattalashardi.

words.definition: Meat is food made of animals.
words.definition_uz: Go'sht hayvonlardan tayyorlangan ovqatdir.
words.example: This piece of meat I’m eating tastes very good.
words.example_uz: Yeyayotganim go'sht bo'lagi juda mazali.

words.definition: An opinion is a thought about a person or a thing.
words.definition_uz: Fikr — bu inson yoki narsa haqidagi fikr.
words.example: Meg told me her opinion of my story. She said it was not funny.
words.example_uz: Meg mening hikoyam haqida o'z fikrini aytdi. U bu kulgili emasligini aytdi.

words.definition: If something is real, it actually exists.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir haqiqiy bo'lsa, u haqiqatan ham mavjud.
words.example: The handbag has a stamp on it, so it’s real.
words.example_uz: Sumkada muhr bor, demak u haqiqiy.

words.definition: To reflect is when a surface sends back light, heat, sound or an image.
words.definition_uz: Aks ettirish — bu sirt yorug'lik, issiqlik, tovush yoki tasvirni orqaga yuborishidir.
words.example: Her face was reflected on the smooth glass.
words.example_uz: Uning yuzi silliq oynada aks etgan edi.

words.definition: To regard someone or something is to think of them in a certain way.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir qadrlash — ularni ma'lum bir tarzda o'ylashdir.
words.example: The boy regarded the girl as a good friend.
words.example_uz: O'g'il bola qizni yaxshi do'st deb hisoblagan.

words.definition: To serve someone is to give them food or drinks.
words.definition_uz: Kimgadir xizmat qilish — unga ovqat yoki ichimlik berishdir.
words.example: He served us our drinks quickly.
words.example_uz: U bizga tezda ichimliklarni berdi.

words.definition: A vegetable is a plant used as food.
words.definition_uz: Sabzavot — bu oziq-ovqat sifatida ishlatiladigan o'simlik.
words.example: Carrots are my favorite vegetable.
words.example_uz: Sabzi mening eng sevimli sabzavotim.

words.definition: A war is a big fight between two groups of people.
words.definition_uz: Urush ikki guruh odamlar o'rtasidagi katta jangdir.
words.example: Many young men died in the war.
words.example_uz: Ko'plab yoshlar urushda halok bo'lgan.

words.definition: If something is worth an amount of money, it costs that amount.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir bir miqdorda pulga arziydigan bo'lsa, u shuncha turadi.
words.example: Our house is worth a lot of money.
words.example_uz: Bizning uyimiz juda qimmat.

words.definition: To appear is to seem.
words.definition_uz: Ko'rinish — ko'rinish.
words.example: She appeared to be sad. She was crying.
words.example_uz: U qayg'uli ko'rindi. U yig'layotgan edi.

words.definition: The base is the bottom of something.
words.definition_uz: Taglik nimadirning tagi.
words.example: The base of the table has three legs.
words.example_uz: Stolning tagida uch oyoq bor.

words.definition: The brain is the organ in your head that lets you think.
words.definition_uz: Miya sizning boshingizdagi o'ylash organidir.
words.example: You must use your brain to solve the problem.
words.example_uz: Muammoni hal qilish uchun miyangizdan foydalanishingiz kerak.

words.definition: A career is a job that you do for a large part of your life.
words.definition_uz: Kasb — bu hayotingizning katta qismini bajaradigan ish.
words.example: He was in the hospitality business for most of his career.
words.example_uz: U o'z faoliyatining ko'p qismini mehmondo'stlik sohasida o'tkazgan.

words.definition: A clerk is a type of worker. Clerks in a store help customers.
words.definition_uz: Kotib — bu ishchi turi. Do'kondagi sotuvchilar mijozlarga yordam beradi.
words.example: The clerk added up her bill for the groceries.
words.example_uz: Xodim oziq-ovqat uchun hisobni qo'shib berdi.

words.definition: Effort is hard work or an attempt to do something.
words.definition_uz: Mehnat — bu qattiq mehnat yoki nimanidir qilishga urinishdir.
words.example: He always puts a lot of effort into his studies.
words.example_uz: U har doim o'qishiga ko'p mehnat qiladi.

words.definition: To enter a place is to go into it.
words.definition_uz: Bir joyga kirish — unga kirishdir.
words.example: Two guards greeted me as I entered the front door.
words.example_uz: Old eshikdan kirganimda ikki qo'riqchi meni kutib oldi.

words.definition: When something is excellent, it is very good.
words.definition_uz: Nimadir a'lo darajada bo'lsa, juda yaxshi bo'ladi.
words.example: I got an excellent score on my school test.
words.example_uz: Maktab imtihonimdan ajoyib ball oldim.

words.definition: A hero is a brave person who does things to help others.
words.definition_uz: Qahramon — boshqalarga yordam berish uchun ish qiladigan jasur inson.
words.example: To children, the man in the blue and red costume was a real hero.
words.example_uz: Bolalar uchun ko'k va qizil kostyumdagi odam haqiqiy qahramon edi.

words.definition: To hurry is to do something quickly.
words.definition_uz: Shoshilish — tez ish qilishdir.
words.example: I hurried home on my bike.
words.example_uz: Men velosipedda uyga shoshildim.

words.definition: To inform someone is to tell them about something.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir xabardor qilish — nimadir haqida aytishdir.
words.example: I called and informed her about my idea.
words.example_uz: Men unga qo'ng'iroq qilib, o'z g'oyam haqida xabar berdim.

words.definition: Later means after the present, expected, or usual time.
words.definition_uz: Keyingi degani hozirgi zamon, kutilgan yoki odatdagi vaqtdan keyin degani.
words.example: She missed the train, so she’ll arrive a little later than expected.
words.example_uz: U poyezdni o'tkazib yubordi, shuning uchun kutilganidan biroz kechroq yetib keladi.

words.definition: To leave means to go away from someone or something.
words.definition_uz: Ketish kimdir yoki nimadandir uzoqlashish degani.
words.example: He packed his bag and was ready to leave for home.
words.example_uz: U sumkasini yig'ib, uyga ketishga tayyor edi.

words.definition: To locate something is to find it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir topish — uni topishdir.
words.example: I could not locate my keys in the house.
words.example_uz: Kalitlarimni uyda topa olmadim.

words.definition: A nurse is a person who helps sick people in the hospital.
words.definition_uz: Hamshira kasalxonadagi kasallarga yordam beradigan odamdir.
words.example: A nurse helped me get better.
words.example_uz: Hamshira menga sog'ayishimga yordam berdi.

words.definition: An operation is when a doctor replaces or removes something in the body.
words.definition_uz: Operatsiya — bu shifokor tanadagi biror narsani almashtirish yoki olib tashlashdir.
words.example: The operation on my arm was a success.
words.example_uz: Qo'limdagi operatsiya muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi.

words.definition: Pain is the feeling that you have when you are hurt.
words.definition_uz: Og'riq — bu jarohatlanganingda his qiladigan his.
words.example: His head was full of pain.
words.example_uz: Boshida og'riq bor edi.

words.definition: To refuse something is to say “no” to it.
words.definition_uz: Rad etish unga "yo'q" deyishdir.
words.example: The dog refused to play with the cat.
words.example_uz: It mushuk bilan o'ynashni rad etdi.

words.definition: Though is used when the second idea makes the first seem surprising.
words.definition_uz: Biroq, ikkinchi g'oya birinchisini hayratlanarli tuyulganida ishlatiladi.
words.example: Though he was overweight, he liked to be active.
words.example_uz: U ortiqcha vaznga ega bo'lsa-da, faol bo'lishni yoqtirardi.

words.definition: If something is various, there are many types of it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir turlicha bo'lsa, uning ko'plab turlari mavjud.
words.example: She owned shoes of various styles.
words.example_uz: U turli uslubdagi poyabzallarga ega edi.

words.definition: Actual means that something is real or true.
words.definition_uz: Haqiqiy degani nimadir haqiqiy yoki haqiqat degani.
words.example: This is the actual sword that the King owned, not a fake one.
words.example_uz: Bu haqiqiy qilich bo'lib, qirol egalik qilgan, soxta emas.

words.definition: To amaze someone is to surprise them very much.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir hayratda qoldirish — uni juda hayratda qoldirishdir.
words.example: The news in the paper amazed Jack.
words.example_uz: Qog'ozdagi yangiliklar Jekni hayratda qoldirdi.

words.definition: A charge is the price to pay for something.
words.definition_uz: To'lov nimadir uchun to'lanadigan narxdir.
words.example: The charge for the shirts was $15.00.
words.example_uz: Ko'ylaklar uchun to'lov $15.00 edi.

words.definition: To comfort someone means to make them feel better.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir taskin berish — bu uni yaxshiroq his qilishdir.
words.example: I wanted to comfort my friend after I heard the bad news.
words.example_uz: Yomon xabarni eshitganimdan keyin do'stimni taskin bermoqchi edim.

words.definition: To contact someone is to speak or write to them.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir bog'lash — gaplashish yoki xat yozishdir.
words.example: I contacted Sue about my party.
words.example_uz: Men Sue bilan partiyam haqida bog'landim.

words.definition: A customer is a person who buys something at a store.
words.definition_uz: Mijoz — bu do'kondan nimadir sotib oladigan odam.
words.example: The customer put a few items in a bag.
words.example_uz: Mijoz bir nechta narsalarni sumkaga solgan.

words.definition: To deliver something is to take it from one place to another.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir yetkazish — uni bir joydan boshqasiga olib borishdir.
words.example: The man delivered Chinese food to my house.
words.example_uz: U odam mening uyimga xitoy taomlarini olib keldi.

words.definition: To earn means to get money for the work you do.
words.definition_uz: Ishlash degani, qilayotgan ishing uchun pul topish.
words.example: He earns his living as a chef in a great restaurant.
words.example_uz: U ajoyib restoranda oshpaz sifatida tirikchilik qiladi.

words.definition: A gate is a type of door. Gates are usually made of metal or wood.
words.definition_uz: Darvoza — bu eshik turi. Darvozalar odatda metall yoki yog'ochdan tayyorlanadi.
words.example: We want to put up a wooden gate around our house.
words.example_uz: Uyimiz atrofiga yog'och darvoza o'rnatmoqchimiz.

words.definition: To include something means to have it as part of a group.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir qo'shish uni guruh tarkibiga qo'shish degani.
words.example: Does this meal include a soft drink?
words.example_uz: Bu ovqatda gazli ichimlik ham bormi?

words.definition: To manage something means to control or be in charge of it.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani boshqarish — uni boshqarish yoki boshqarish degani.
words.example: I had to manage the meeting myself.
words.example_uz: Uchrashuvni o'zim boshqarishim kerak edi.

words.definition: A mystery is something that is difficult to understand or explain.
words.definition_uz: Sir — bu tushunish yoki tushuntirish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.
words.example: The path on the map was a complete mystery to me.
words.example_uz: Xaritadagi yo'l men uchun to'liq sir edi.

words.definition: To occur means to happen.
words.definition_uz: Sodir bo'lish — bu sodir bo'lishdir.
words.example: When did the thunderstorm occur?
words.example_uz: Momaqaldiroq qachon bo'ldi?

words.definition: If A is the opposite of B, A is completely different from B.
words.definition_uz: Agar A B ning teskarisi bo'lsa, A B dan butunlay farq qiladi.
words.example: The opposite of black is white.
words.example_uz: Qora rangning teskarisi — oq rang.

words.definition: A plate is a flat round thing that you put food on.
words.definition_uz: Likopcha — bu ovqat qo'yiladigan yassi yumaloq narsa.
words.example: I put my plate down so I could put some food on it.
words.example_uz: Likopchamni qo'ydim, ustiga ovqat qo'yish uchun.

words.definition: To receive something is to get it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir olish — uni olishdir.
words.example: I received a present on my birthday.
words.example_uz: Tug'ilgan kunimda sovg'a oldim.

words.definition: A reward is something given in exchange for good behavior or work.
words.definition_uz: Mukofot — bu yaxshi xulq yoki ish evaziga beriladigan narsa.
words.example: He was given a reward for his excellent performance.
words.example_uz: U a'lo darajadagi o'yini uchun mukofot oldi.

words.definition: To set something is to put it somewhere.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir o'rnatish uni bir joyga qo'yishdir.
words.example: Please set the dice down on the table.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, zarlarni stolga qo'ying.

words.definition: To steal is to take something that is not yours.
words.definition_uz: O'g'irlash o'zingga tegishli bo'lmagan narsani olishdir.
words.example: The men tried to steal money from the bank.
words.example_uz: Erkaklar bankdan pul o'g'irlashga urinishdi.

words.definition: A thief is someone who quietly takes things that do not belong to them.
words.definition_uz: O'g'ri — bu o'ziga tegishli bo'lmagan narsalarni jimjitlik bilan olib ketadigan odam.
words.example: A thief broke into our home and took my mother's jewelry.
words.example_uz: Bir o'g'ri uyimizga bostirib kirib, onamning zargarlik buyumlarini olib ketdi.

words.definition: To advance is to go forward.
words.definition_uz: Oldinga yurish oldinga yurishdir.
words.example: He advanced up the ladder slowly.
words.example_uz: U asta-sekin yuqoriga ko'tarildi.

words.definition: An athlete is a person who plays sports.
words.definition_uz: Sportchi — bu sport bilan shug'ullanuvchi inson.
words.example: Some athletes can play many sports very well.
words.example_uz: Ba'zi sportchilar ko'plab sport turlarini juda yaxshi ijro eta oladi.

words.definition: If something is average, it is at a normal level.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir o'rtacha bo'lsa, u normal darajada.
words.example: I’m not rich or poor; I’m average.
words.example_uz: Men boy yoki kambag'al emasman; Men o'rtachaman.

words.definition: Your behavior is the way you act.
words.definition_uz: Sizning xulq-atvoringiz sizning harakatingizdir.
words.example: Their behavior was good this semester. They didn’t cause trouble.
words.example_uz: Ularning xulq-atvori bu semestrda yaxshi edi. Ular muammo tug'dirmadi.

words.definition: Behind means to be at the back of something.
words.definition_uz: Orqada bo'lish nimaningdir orqasida bo'lish degani.
words.example: The little girl was hiding behind a tree.
words.example_uz: Kichkina qiz daraxt ortida yashirinib yotgan edi.

words.definition: A course is a class in school.
words.definition_uz: Kurs maktabda darsdir.
words.example: I took a P.E. course in school this year.
words.example_uz: Bu yil maktabda jismoniy tarbiya kursini oldim.

words.definition: To lower something is to make it go down.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir pastga tushirish uni pastga tushirishdir.
words.example: The chart shows how his production has lowered over the year.
words.example_uz: Diagramma yil davomida uning ishlab chiqarish darajasi qanday pasayganini ko'rsatadi.

words.definition: To match is to be the same or similar.
words.definition_uz: Moslashtirish — bu bir xil yoki o'xshash bo'lishdir.
words.example: The two shoes matched. They looked the same.
words.example_uz: Ikkala poyabzal mos keldi. Ular bir xil ko'rinardi.

words.definition: A member is a person who is part of a group.
words.definition_uz: A'zo — bu guruh a'zosi bo'lgan shaxs.
words.example: Julie is the newest member of our team.
words.example_uz: Julie jamoamizning eng yangi a'zosi.

words.definition: If something is mental, it has to do with your mind.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir aqliy bo'lsa, bu sening onging bilan bog'liq.
words.example: I made a mental picture of the room.
words.example_uz: Men xonani xayoliy tasvirga oldim.

words.definition: A passenger is a person who rides in a car, train, or airplane.
words.definition_uz: Yo'lovchi — bu avtomobil, poyezd yoki samolyotda sayohat qiladigan shaxsdir.
words.example: One passenger was standing in the subway train.
words.example_uz: Bir yo'lovchi metro poyezdida turardi.

words.definition: Your personality is what you are like and how you behave.
words.definition_uz: Sizning shaxsiyatingiz sizning qanday ekanligingiz va qanday xulq-atvoringiz bilan bog'liq.
words.example: John has a bad personality.
words.example_uz: Jonning xarakteri yomon.

words.definition: A poem is a short kind of writing.
words.definition_uz: She'r — bu qisqa yozuv turi.
words.example: William Shakespeare wrote many poems.
words.example_uz: Uilyam Shekspir ko'plab she'rlar yozgan.

words.definition: A pole is a long thin stick made of wood or metal that supports things.
words.definition_uz: Tayoq — bu yog'och yoki metalldan yasalgan uzun, ingichka tayoq bo'lib, narsalarni ushlab turadi.
words.example: The flag was hanging from the flag pole.
words.example_uz: Bayroq bayroq ustunidan osilib turardi.

words.definition: To remove something is to take it away.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir olib tashlash uni olib qo'yishdir.
words.example: I removed the nail from the board.
words.example_uz: Men mixni taxtadan olib tashladim.

words.definition: Safety means to be the condition of being safe and free from danger.
words.definition_uz: Xavfsizlik xavfsiz va xavfsiz bo'lish sharti degani.
words.example: For his own safety, he was placed in a car seat.
words.example_uz: O'z xavfsizligi uchun uni mashina o'rindig'iga joylashtirishdi.

words.definition: To shoot is to fire something like a bullet at someone or something.
words.definition_uz: O'q uzish — kimnidir yoki nimagadir o'q uzishdir.
words.example: The hunter raised his gun to shoot at the target.
words.example_uz: Ovchi nishonga o'q uzish uchun qurolini ko'tardi.

words.definition: To sound means to make a noise.
words.definition_uz: Ovoz chiqarish — shovqin chiqarish.
words.example: The alarm clock sounded and woke us all up.
words.example_uz: Budilnik chalindi va barchamizni uyg'otdi.

words.definition: To swim is to move through water.
words.definition_uz: Suzish suvda harakatlanishdir.
words.example: I love to swim in the ocean.
words.example_uz: Men okeanda suzishni yaxshi ko'raman.

words.definition: A web is a net made by a spider to catch insects.
words.definition_uz: O'rgimchak to'ri — hasharotlarni tutish uchun o'rgimchak to'qiydigan to'rdir.
words.example: Mom cleaned the spider webs out of the garage.
words.example_uz: Onam garajdan o'rgimchak to'rlarini tozaladi.

words.definition: A block is a solid piece of wood, stone or ice.
words.definition_uz: Blok — bu qattiq yog'och, tosh yoki muzdan yasalgan bo'lak.
words.example: I saw a block of ice on the floor.
words.example_uz: Polda muz blokini ko'rdim.

words.definition: To cheer is to give a loud shout of approval or encouragement.
words.definition_uz: Olqishlash — bu baland ovozda tasdiqlash yoki rag'batlantirish baqirishdir.
words.example: The crowd all cheered when the home team won.
words.example_uz: Tomoshabinlar mezbon jamoa g'alaba qozonganida olqishladi.

words.definition: If something is complex, it has many small parts. It is hard to understand.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir murakkab bo'lsa, unda ko'plab kichik qismlar bor. Buni tushunish qiyin.
words.example: A jig-saw puzzle can be complex because it has so many pieces.
words.example_uz: Pazl jumboq murakkab bo'lishi mumkin, chunki unda juda ko'p bo'laklar bor.

words.definition: A critic is someone who give their opinions about movies, books, plays.
words.definition_uz: Tanqidchi — bu filmlar, kitoblar, pyesalar haqida o'z fikrini bildiradigan kishi.
words.example: The wine critic tasted the wine so he could give his opinion.
words.example_uz: Vino tanqidchisi sharobni tatib ko'rib, o'z fikrini bildirdi.

words.definition: An event is something that happens, especially something important.
words.definition_uz: Voqea — bu sodir bo'ladigan narsa, ayniqsa muhim narsa.
words.example: Finishing high school was a major event in his life.
words.example_uz: O'rta maktabni tugatish uning hayotida katta voqea bo'ldi.

words.definition: To exercise is to run or play sports so that you can be healthy.
words.definition_uz: Jismoniy mashq qilish sog'lom bo'lish uchun yugurish yoki sport bilan shug'ullanishdir.
words.example: You should exercise every day.
words.example_uz: Har kuni mashq qilishing kerak.

words.definition: If something fits, it is small enough or the right size to go there.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir mos kelsa, u yetarlicha kichik yoki to'g'ri o'lchamda bo'ladi.
words.example: The colorful eggs fit into the box.
words.example_uz: Rang-barang tuxumlar qutiga sig'adi.

words.definition: Friendship is the relationship between people who are friends.
words.definition_uz: Do'stlik — bu do'st bo'lgan odamlar o'rtasidagi munosabat.
words.example: Michael and Lisa have a very strong friendship with each other.
words.example_uz: Maykl va Liza o'rtasida juda mustahkam do'stlik bor.

words.definition: A guide is someone who shows you where to go.
words.definition_uz: Yo'lboshchi — bu qayerga borishni ko'rsatadigan odam.
words.example: We followed a guide at the park.
words.example_uz: Biz bog'da qo'llanmani kuzatdik.

words.definition: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yetishmasa, yetarli emas.
words.example: His only problem is a lack of money.
words.example_uz: Uning yagona muammosi pul yetishmasligi.

words.definition: A passage is a long area with walls that goes from one place to another.
words.definition_uz: Yo'lak — devorlari bilan uzun maydon bo'lib, u bir joydan boshqasiga olib boradi.
words.example: The long passage led us to the other side of the field.
words.example_uz: Uzoq yo'l bizni daladan boshqa tomonga olib bordi.

words.definition: To perform is to do something in front of people who watch.
words.definition_uz: Ijro etish — bu tomosha qilayotgan odamlar oldida nimadir qilishdir.
words.example: He will perform a song for the class.
words.example_uz: U sinf uchun qo'shiq ijro etadi.

words.definition: Pressure is what you apply to make someone do something.
words.definition_uz: Bosim — bu kimnidir biror narsa qilishga majbur qilish uchun qo'llanilayotgan narsa.
words.example: They put pressure on him to change his mind.
words.example_uz: Unga fikrini o'zgartirish uchun bosim o'tkazishdi.

words.definition: If something is probable, it is likely to happen.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir ehtimol bo'lsa, u ehtimol sodir bo'lishi mumkin.
words.example: It is probable that you will get a good grade if you study for the test.
words.example_uz: Agar imtihonga tayyorlansangiz, yaxshi baho olishingiz mumkin.

words.definition: If something is public, it is meant for everyone to use.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir ommaga ochiq bo'lsa, u hamma foydalanishi uchun mo'ljallangan.
words.example: I went to the public park to play with my friends.
words.example_uz: Do'stlarim bilan uchun jamoat bog'iga bordim.

words.definition: To strike someone or something is to hit them.
words.definition_uz: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir urish — urishdir.
words.example: She struck the other girl in the face.
words.example_uz: U boshqa qizning yuziga urdi.

words.definition: To support something is to like it and help it be successful.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir qo'llab-quvvatlash — uni yoqtirish va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishiga yordam berishdir.
words.example: Everyone at work supports the new plan.
words.example_uz: Ishdagi hamma yangi rejani qo'llab-quvvatlaydi.

words.definition: A task is work that someone has to do.
words.definition_uz: Vazifa — bu kimdir bajarishi kerak bo'lgan ish.
words.example: Who has the task of building the brick wall?
words.example_uz: G'isht devorni qurish vazifasi kimda?

words.definition: A term is a word for something.
words.definition_uz: Atama nimanidir anglatadigan so'zdir.
words.example: I often use the term “oops” when I make a mistake.
words.example_uz: Men ko'pincha xato qilganimda "oops" so'zini ishlataman.

words.definition: To unite is to get together to do something.
words.definition_uz: Birlashish — birlashib, nimadir qilishdir.
words.example: If we unite, we can finish our project faster.
words.example_uz: Agar birlashsak, loyihamizni tezroq yakunlaymiz.

words.definition: To associate means to connect something with a person or thing.
words.definition_uz: Bog'lash — bu biror narsani odam yoki narsa bilan bog'lash degani.
words.example: Most people associate birthday parties with having fun.
words.example_uz: Ko'pchilik tug'ilgan kunlarni zavqlanish bilan bog'laydi.

words.definition: The environment is the place where people work or live.
words.definition_uz: Atrof-muhit odamlar ishlaydigan yoki yashaydigan joydir.
words.example: Keeping our environment clean is important to our health.
words.example_uz: Atrof-muhitimizni toza saqlash sog'lig'imiz uchun muhim.

words.definition: A factory is a building where things are made or put together.
words.definition_uz: Fabrika — bu narsalar tayyorlanadigan yoki yig'iladigan bino.
words.example: We have only one factory in our town.
words.example_uz: Shaharimizda faqat bitta fabrika bor.

words.definition: A feature is an important part of something.
words.definition_uz: Xususiyat nimaningdir muhim qismidir.
words.example: The cell phone has many features.
words.example_uz: Mobil telefon ko'plab funksiyalarga ega.

words.definition: An instance is an example of something.
words.definition_uz: Instansiya nimagadir misoldir.
words.example: I have never experienced an instance of hate. Have you?
words.example_uz: Men hech qachon nafrat holatini boshdan kechirmaganman. Shundaymi?

words.definition: To involve means to be actively taking part in something.
words.definition_uz: Ishtirok etish — nimadadir faol ishtirok etish degani.
words.example: The whole family was involved in playing the game.
words.example_uz: Butun oila o'yinda ishtirok etdi.

words.definition: Medicine is something you take to feel better or treat an illness.
words.definition_uz: Dori — bu o'zingizni yaxshi his qilish yoki kasallikni davolash uchun qabul qilinadigan narsa.
words.example: The doctor gave me medicine for my cold.
words.example_uz: Shifokor menga shamollash uchun dori berdi.

words.definition: A mix is different things put together.
words.definition_uz: Aralashma — bu turli narsalarni birlashtiriladi.
words.example: The green mix we made in science class spilled onto the table.
words.example_uz: Fan darsida tayyorlagan yashil aralashma stolga to'kilib ketdi.

words.definition: To organize is to plan or get ready for an event.
words.definition_uz: Tashkil etish — bu tadbirni rejalashtirish yoki tayyorlanishdir.
words.example: Make a list to help you organize the things you need.
words.example_uz: Kerakli narsalarni tartibga solishing uchun ro'yxat tuz.

words.definition: A period is an amount of time when something happens.
words.definition_uz: Davr — bu nimadir sodir bo'lgan vaqt.
words.example: In one period in Europe, there were many knights.
words.example_uz: Yevropada bir davrda ko'plab ritsarlar bo'lgan.

words.definition: If people populate an area, they live there.
words.definition_uz: Agar odamlar bir hududda yashasa, ular o'sha yerda yashaydi.
words.example: Billions of people populate the Earth.
words.example_uz: Yerda milliardlab odamlar yashaydi.

words.definition: To produce something is to make or grow it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir yaratish — uni yaratish yoki o'stirish.
words.example: This tree produces apples every year.
words.example_uz: Bu daraxt har yili olma yetishtiradi.

words.definition: A range is a number or a set of similar things.
words.definition_uz: Range — bu raqam yoki shunga o'xshash narsalar to'plami.
words.example: I saw a range of cars to choose from.
words.example_uz: Tanlash uchun turli xil mashinalarni ko'rdim.

words.definition: To recognize something is to know it because you have seen it before.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir tan olish — uni ilgari ko'rganing uchun bilishdir.
words.example: I recognized an old friend from many years ago.
words.example_uz: Men ko'p yillar oldingi eski do'stimni tanidim.

words.definition: If something is regular, it happens often and in equal amounts of time.
words.definition_uz: Agar biror narsa muntazam bo'lsa, u tez-tez va teng vaqt ichida sodir bo'ladi.
words.example: Our regular lunch time is around noon.
words.example_uz: Bizning odatdagi tushlik vaqtimiz taxminan peshin atrofida.

words.definition: A sign is a notice giving information, directions, a warning, etc.
words.definition_uz: Belgi — bu ma'lumot, yo'nalish, ogohlantirish va boshqalarni ko'rsatuvchi e'lon.
words.example: The sign indicated that today would be a bad day.
words.example_uz: Belgi bugun yomon kun bo'lishini ko'rsatardi.

words.definition: A tip is a pointed end of something.
words.definition_uz: Choychaqa nimadirning o'tkir oxiri.
words.example: The tip of his pen was very sharp.
words.example_uz: Ruchkasining uchi juda o'tkir edi.

words.definition: A tradition is something people have been doing for a long time.
words.definition_uz: An'ana — bu odamlar uzoq vaqtdan beri qiladigan ish.
words.example: Marriage is a tradition all over the world.
words.example_uz: Nikoh butun dunyoda an'anaga aylangan.

words.definition: Trash is waste material or unwanted or worthless things.
words.definition_uz: Chiqindi — bu chiqindi yoki keraksiz yoki befoyda narsalar.
words.example: Please take out the trash; it smells bad.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, axlatni chiqaring; Yomon hid kelmoqda.

words.definition: If something is wide, it is large from side to side.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir keng bo'lsa, u yonma-yon katta bo'ladi.
words.example: The door was as wide as my arms.
words.example_uz: Eshik qo'llarimdek keng edi.

words.definition: Advice is an opinion about what to do.
words.definition_uz: Maslahat — bu nima qilish kerakligi haqidagi fikr.
words.example: I don’t know how to study for my exams. Can you give me some advice?
words.example_uz: Imtihonlarimga qanday tayyorlanishni bilmayman. Menga maslahat bera olasizmi?

words.definition: Along means to move from one part of a road, river, etc. to another.
words.definition_uz: Along degani yo'l, daryo va boshqalarning bir qismidan boshqasiga o'tishni anglatadi.
words.example: Walk along this tunnel for ten minutes, and you’ll see a door on the left.
words.example_uz: Bu tunnel bo'ylab o'n daqiqa yuring, chap tomonda eshikni ko'rasiz.

words.definition: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.
words.definition_uz: E'tibor — bu kimningdir e'tibori, fikri yoki e'tibori.
words.example: His work got the attention of two of his co-workers.
words.example_uz: Uning ishi ikki hamkasbining e'tiborini tortdi.

words.definition: To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be interested.
words.definition_uz: Jalb qilish — bu odam yoki narsani yaqinlashtirish yoki qiziqish bildirish degani.
words.example: The magnet attracted the metal.
words.example_uz: Magnit metallni o'ziga tortdi.

words.definition: To climb means to use your hands and feet to go up on something.
words.definition_uz: Chiqish degani qo'l va oyoqlaring bilan nimagadir chiqish degani.
words.example: The girls climbed to the top of the mountain.
words.example_uz: Qizlar tog' cho'qqisiga chiqishdi.

words.definition: To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.
words.definition_uz: Tushirish — bu yiqilish yoki nimanidir yiqilishiga yo'l qo'yishdir.
words.example: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.
words.example_uz: Shishadan ozgina suv tushdi.

words.definition: If something is final, it is the last part.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yakuniy bo'lsa, u oxirgi qismdir.
words.example: In the final part of the film, the man and the woman got married.
words.example_uz: Filmning oxirgi qismida erkak va ayol turmush qurishadi.

words.definition: Further is used to say something is from a distance or time.
words.definition_uz: Further so'zi masofadan yoki vaqtdan kelgan narsani aytish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example: The escalator is further along than I thought.
words.example_uz: Eskalator o'ylaganimdan ancha oldinga.

words.definition: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir ishora qilish — uni aytmasdan taklif qilishdir.
words.example: The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn’t say so.
words.example_uz: Erkak ishni xohlashini aytdi, lekin aytmadi.

words.definition: To maintain means to make something stay the same.
words.definition_uz: Saqlab qolish degani nimanidir o'zgarmasligini anglatadi.
words.example: The balls maintain constant movement.
words.example_uz: Sharlar doimiy harakatda bo'ladi.

words.definition: You use neither to connect two negative statements.
words.definition_uz: Siz ikki salbiy bayonotni bog'lash uchun ikkalasini ham ishlatmaysiz.
words.example: Neither the pass on the left nor the pass on the right will lead us home.
words.example_uz: Chapdagi pas ham, o'ngdagi pas ham bizni uyga olib bormaydi.

words.definition: Otherwise means different or in another way.
words.definition_uz: Aks holda boshqacha yoki boshqa ma'noda.
words.example: It’s good to stay active; otherwise, you’ll gain weight.
words.example_uz: Faol bo'lish yaxshi; Aks holda, vazning oshadi.

words.definition: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir jismoniy bo'lsa, u tanangizga bog'liq, aqlingiz bilan emas.
words.example: Biking is good for your physical health.
words.example_uz: Velosipedda yurish jismoniy sog'liq uchun foydali.

words.definition: To prove something is to show that it is true.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir isbotlash — bu uning rostligini isbotlashdir.
words.example: My teacher proved the answer on the board.
words.example_uz: O'qituvchim javobni doskada isbotladi.

words.definition: To react is to act in a certain way because of something that happened.
words.definition_uz: Javob berish — bu sodir bo'lgan voqea sababli ma'lum bir tarzda harakat qilishdir.
words.example: James reacted badly to the news.
words.example_uz: Jeyms bu yangilikka yomon munosabatda bo'ldi.

words.definition: To ride something is to travel on it. You can ride an animal, a bike, etc.
words.definition_uz: Nimagadir minish — unda sayohat qilishdir. Siz hayvon, velosiped va hokazo minishingiz mumkin.
words.example: I will ride a roller-coaster for the first time today.
words.example_uz: Bugun birinchi marta rolikli attraksionda yuraman.

words.definition: If something is situated somewhere, it is in that place.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir qayerdadir joylashgan bo'lsa, u o'sha joyda.
words.example: The white board is situated between the two men.
words.example_uz: Oq taxta ikki erkak orasida joylashgan.

words.definition: Society is people and the way that they live.
words.definition_uz: Jamiyat — bu odamlar va ularning yashash tarzi.
words.example: Society expects people to be good and honest.
words.example_uz: Jamiyat odamlardan yaxshi va halol bo'lishni kutadi.

words.definition: A standard is what people consider normal or good.
words.definition_uz: Standart — bu odamlar normal yoki yaxshi deb hisoblaydigan narsa.
words.example: This older model TV is below our store’s standards.
words.example_uz: Bu eski model televizor do'konimiz standartlaridan past.

words.definition: To suggest something means to give an idea or plan about it.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir taklif qilish — bu unga oid g'oya yoki reja berish degani.
words.example: He suggested that we go to see his boss.
words.example_uz: U bizga o'z boshlig'i bilan uchrashishni taklif qildi.

words.definition: Actually means in fact or really.
words.definition_uz: Haqiqatan ham yoki haqiqatan ham degani.
words.example: My dad looks a little mean, but actually he’s very kind.
words.example_uz: Otam biroz yomon ko'rinadi, lekin aslida juda mehribon.

words.definition: Bite is the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something.
words.definition_uz: Tishlash — bu tishlaring bilan nimanidir kesib, yirtib tashlash harakati.
words.example: The boy took a big bite out of his hamburger.
words.example_uz: Bola gamburgeridan katta tishladi.

words.definition: The coast is the land by an ocean.
words.definition_uz: Sohil okean bo'yidagi quruqlikdir.
words.example: I stayed on the southern coast of Australia.
words.example_uz: Men Avstraliyaning janubiy sohilida qoldim.

words.definition: A deal is an agreement that you have with another person.
words.definition_uz: Kelishuv — bu boshqa odam bilan tuzilgan kelishuv.
words.example: I made a deal with the other company to give us some money.
words.example_uz: Men boshqa kompaniya bilan pul berish uchun kelishuv qildim.

words.definition: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.
words.definition_uz: Cho'l — ko'p o'simliklar va suvga ega bo'lmagan yer maydoni.
words.example: Not many plants grow in the desert.
words.example_uz: Cho'lda ko'p o'simliklar o'smaydi.

words.definition: An earthquake is a shaking movement of the ground.
words.definition_uz: Zilzila — bu yerning silkinayotgan harakati.
words.example: The building shook during the earthquake.
words.example_uz: Zilzila paytida bino silkindi.

words.definition: If something is effective, it works well.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir samarali bo'lsa, yaxshi ishlaydi.
words.example: Swimming is an effective way to stay healthy.
words.example_uz: Suzish sog'lom bo'lishning samarali usuli.

words.definition: To examine something is to look at it carefully.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir tekshirish — uni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqishdir.
words.example: The doctor examined my eyes today.
words.example_uz: Doktor bugun ko'zlarimni ko'rdi.

words.definition: If something is false, it is not correct.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir noto'g'ri bo'lsa, u noto'g'ri.
words.example: If you think the answer is false, press the red button.
words.example_uz: Agar javob noto'g'ri deb o'ylasangiz, qizil tugmani bosing.

words.definition: A gift is something you give someone.
words.definition_uz: Sovg'a - bu kimgadir beradigan narsadir.
words.example: Dave received many gifts for Christmas.
words.example_uz: Dave Rojdestvo uchun ko'plab sovg'alar oldi.

words.definition: Hunger is the feeling that you get when you need to eat.
words.definition_uz: Ochlik — ovqat yeyish kerak bo'lganda his qilinadigan his.
words.example: After playing all day long, he was filled with hunger.
words.example_uz: Kun bo'yi o'ynaganidan so'ng, u ochlikdan to'lib ketdi.

words.definition: To imagine something is to think of it in your mind.
words.definition_uz: Tasavvur qilish — uni ongingizda o'ylashdir.
words.example: Sally imagined herself winning lots of money.
words.example_uz: Sally o'zini ko'p pul yutayotganini tasavvur qilgan.

words.definition: A journey is a long trip.
words.definition_uz: Sayohat uzoq sayohat.
words.example: I went on a journey across the country with my parents.
words.example_uz: Men ota-onam bilan mamlakat bo'ylab sayohatga chiqdim.

words.definition: A puzzle is something that is hard to understand.
words.definition_uz: Jumboq — bu tushunish qiyin bo'lgan narsa.
words.example: The question was a puzzle to him.
words.example_uz: Bu savol unga jumboq edi.

words.definition: Quite is used to say that something is complete or very much.
words.definition_uz: Quite so'zi nimadir to'liq yoki juda ko'p ekanligini aytish uchun ishlatiladi.
words.example: I think typing on a keyboard is quite easy.
words.example_uz: Menimcha, klaviaturada yozish juda oson.

words.definition: Rather is used when you want to do one thing but not the other.
words.definition_uz: Rather bir ishni qilishni xohlasang, boshqasini qilmasang ishlatiladi.
words.example: I would rather have the red one than the blue one.
words.example_uz: Men ko'kdan ko'ra qizilini afzal ko'raman.

words.definition: If something is specific, it is precise or exact.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir aniq bo'lsa, u aniq yoki aniq.
words.example: Please choose a specific place on the map.
words.example_uz: Iltimos, xaritada aniq joyni tanlang.

words.definition: A tour is a short trip in which you see many sights.
words.definition_uz: Sayohat — bu qisqa sayohat bo'lib, unda ko'plab diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'rasiz.
words.example: I took a tour of Asia and Europe.
words.example_uz: Men Osiyo va Yevropa bo'ylab sayohat qildim.

words.definition: A trip is a journey to a certain place.
words.definition_uz: Sayohat ma'lum bir joyga sayohatdir.
words.example: Ken took a trip to the city yesterday.
words.example_uz: Ken kecha shaharga sayohat qildi.

words.definition: If something has value, it is worth a lot of money.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir qadrli bo'lsa, u ko'p pulga arziydi.
words.example: Matthew found a treasure of very high value.
words.example_uz: Matthew juda qimmatbaho xazina topdi.

words.definition: A band is a group of people who play music.
words.definition_uz: Guruh — bu musiqa ijro etadigan odamlar guruhi.
words.example: My brother is in a rock band.
words.example_uz: Akam rok guruhida.

words.definition: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.
words.definition_uz: Eng kichik miqdor bilan deyarli yo'q, deyarli yo'q.
words.example: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.
words.example_uz: Menda avtobus chiptasini to'lashga zo'rg'a pul bor edi.

words.definition: If something is boring, it is not fun.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir zerikarli bo'lsa, u qiziqarli emas.
words.example: I think the Internet is boring.
words.example_uz: Menimcha, internet zerikarli.

words.definition: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.
words.definition_uz: Bekor qilish — bu tadbir yoki so'rov bo'lmasligini hal qilish degani.
words.example: She cancelled the rest of her plans because of the rain.
words.example_uz: U yomg'ir sababli qolgan rejalarini bekor qildi.

words.definition: A driveway is a short private road that leads to a person’s home.
words.definition_uz: Haydovchi yo'li — bu qisqa shaxsiy yo'l bo'lib, u odamning uyiga olib boradi.
words.example: The long driveway led us to their new house.
words.example_uz: Uzun yo'l bizni ularning yangi uyiga olib bordi.

words.definition: Garbage is waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.
words.definition_uz: Chiqindi — bu keraksiz yoki buzilgan oziq-ovqat, shisha, qog'oz va boshqalar kabi chiqindi materiallar.
words.example: The boy cleaned up the garbage around his house.
words.example_uz: Bola uyining atrofidagi chiqindilarni tozaladi.

words.definition: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like music.
words.definition_uz: Asbob — bu musiqa kabi ma'lum vazifani bajarish uchun mo'ljallangan narsa.
words.example: My favorite musical instrument is the piano.
words.example_uz: Mening eng sevimli musiqa asbobim pianino.

words.definition: A list is a record of information printed with an item on each line.
words.definition_uz: Ro'yxat — bu har bir qatorda element bo'lgan ma'lumotlar yozuvi.
words.example: My mom makes a list of groceries to buy.
words.example_uz: Onam sotib olish uchun oziq-ovqat ro'yxatini tuzadi.

words.definition: Magic is the power to do impossible things.
words.definition_uz: Sehr imkonsiz ishlarni qilish kuchidir.
words.example: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.
words.example_uz: Sehrgar sehr yordamida shlyapasidan quyon chiqarib oldi.

words.definition: A message is a set of words that you send to someone.
words.definition_uz: Xabar — bu kimgadir yuboriladigan so'zlar to'plami.
words.example: I left a message for you in the envelope.
words.example_uz: Senga konvertda xabar qoldirdim.

words.definition: To notice something is to see it for the first time.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani payqash — uni birinchi marta ko'rish.
words.example: Did you notice the view?
words.example_uz: Manzarani payqadingmi?

words.definition: To own something means to have it. That thing belongs to you.
words.definition_uz: Nimagadir egalik qilish — unga ega bo'lishdir. Bu narsa senga tegishli.
words.example: My grandfather owns that house.
words.example_uz: Bobom o'sha uyning egasi.

words.definition: To predict something is to say that it will happen.
words.definition_uz: Bir narsani oldindan aytish — bu uning sodir bo'lishini aytishdir.
words.example: She predicted that I would get married next year.
words.example_uz: U men kelasi yili turmushga chiqaman deb bashorat qilgan.

words.definition: A professor is a person who teaches in college.
words.definition_uz: Professor — bu kollejda dars beradigan shaxs.
words.example: Mike’s science professor knows a lot about physics.
words.example_uz: Mike'ning fan professori fizika haqida ko'p narsani biladi.

words.definition: To rush is to go somewhere or do something very quickly.
words.definition_uz: Shoshilish — bu tezda biror joyga borish yoki biror ish qilishdir.
words.example: Nancy rushed to finish her homework.
words.example_uz: Nensi uy vazifasini tugatishga shoshildi.

words.definition: A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.
words.definition_uz: Jadval - bu qachon ish qilishni aytadigan reja.
words.example: What is your class schedule for today?
words.example_uz: Bugungi dars jadvalingiz qanday?

words.definition: To share something is to give some of it to another person.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir baham ko'rish — uning bir qismini boshqa odamga berishdir.
words.example: Jimmy shared his apple with me.
words.example_uz: Jimmi olmasini men bilan bo'lishdi.

words.definition: A stage is a place where actors or musicians act or sing.
words.definition_uz: Sahna — aktyorlar yoki musiqachilar ijro etadigan yoki kuylaydigan joy.
words.example: A large screen was on the stage.
words.example_uz: Sahnada katta ekran bor edi.

words.definition: A storm is very bad weather. There is a lot of rain or snow.
words.definition_uz: Bo'ron juda yomon ob-havo. Ko'p yomg'ir yoki qor yog'adi.
words.example: Did that storm wake you up last night?
words.example_uz: Kecha bo'ron seni uyg'otdimi?

words.definition: You use within to say that something is inside another thing.
words.definition_uz: Ichini boshqa narsaning ichida nimadir bor deb aytish uchun ishlatasan.
words.example: Within the box, there was a pizza.
words.example_uz: Qutida pizza bor edi.

words.definition: To advertise is to tell people about something on TV, radio, etc.
words.definition_uz: Reklama qilish — bu televizor, radio va boshqalarda biror narsa haqida gapirishdir.
words.example: They used a rabbit to help them advertise their product.
words.example_uz: Ular mahsulotlarini reklama qilish uchun quyondan foydalangan.

words.definition: To assign something to someone is to tell them to do it.
words.definition_uz: Kimgadir nimanidir topshirish — uni bajarishni aytishdir.
words.example: I assigned the worker an important task.
words.example_uz: Men ishchiga muhim vazifa berdim.

words.definition: An audience is a group of people who watch something together.
words.definition_uz: Tomoshabinlar — bu birga tomosha qiladigan odamlar guruhi.
words.example: There was a large audience at the game.
words.example_uz: O'yinda katta tomoshabinlar bor edi.

words.definition: Breakfast is the first meal of the day.
words.definition_uz: Nonushta kunning birinchi ovqatidir.
words.example: I eat breakfast at 8:00 every morning.
words.example_uz: Men har kuni soat 8:00 da nonushta qilaman.

words.definition: A competition is a contest to see who is the best at something.
words.definition_uz: Musobaqa — bu kim nimadadir eng yaxshi ekanini aniqlash uchun o'tkaziladigan tanlovdir.
words.example: He won the running competition over the weekend.
words.example_uz: U hafta oxirida yugurish musobaqasida g'olib bo'ldi.

words.definition: If the weather is cool, it is a little bit cold.
words.definition_uz: Agar ob-havo salqin bo'lsa, biroz sovuq.
words.example: The weather is cool in the fall.
words.example_uz: Kuzda ob-havo salqin.

words.definition: If you gain something, you get more of it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir olsang, undan ko'proq olasan.
words.example: I gained some weight over the summer.
words.example_uz: Yozda biroz vazn oldim.

words.definition: Importance means the quality or condition of being needed or valued.
words.definition_uz: Muhimlik — zarur bo'lish yoki qadrlanish sifati yoki holatini anglatadi.
words.example: VIPs are people of great importance.
words.example_uz: VIPlar juda muhim insonlardir.

words.definition: Knowledge is information that you have about something.
words.definition_uz: Bilim — bu nimadir haqida sizda bor ma'lumot.
words.example: A music teacher should have good knowledge of music.
words.example_uz: Musiqa o'qituvchisi musiqa bo'yicha yaxshi bilimga ega bo'lishi kerak.

words.definition: If something is major, it is big or important.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir muhim bo'lsa, u katta yoki muhim.
words.example: I have a major problem. My boss wants me to redo my project!
words.example_uz: Menda katta muammo bor. Mening boshlig'im loyihamni qayta qilishimni xohlayapti!

words.definition: Mean describes someone who is unkind or cruel.
words.definition_uz: Yomon so'zi yomon yoki shafqatsiz bo'lgan odamni ifodalaydi.
words.example: My co-worker is a very mean person. He gets angry very quickly.
words.example_uz: Hamkasbim juda yomon odam. U juda tez jahli chiqadi.

words.definition: If you prefer something, you want it more than something else.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimanidir yoqtirsangiz, uni boshqa narsadan ko'ra ko'proq xohlaysiz.
words.example: I prefer to take the path that will lead me to a bright future.
words.example_uz: Men yorqin kelajakka olib boradigan yo'lni tanlashni afzal ko'raman.

words.definition: A president is the leader of a country.
words.definition_uz: Prezident mamlakat rahbaridir.
words.example: The president of our country made an important announcement.
words.example_uz: Mamlakatimiz prezidenti muhim e'lon qildi.

words.definition: Progress is the act of getting closer to doing or finishing something.
words.definition_uz: Taraqqiyot — bu nimanidir bajarish yoki tugatishga yaqinlashish harakatidir.
words.example: Our company made financial progress this year.
words.example_uz: Kompaniyamiz bu yil moliyaviy yutuqlarga erishdi.

words.definition: Respect is a good opinion of someone because they are good.
words.definition_uz: Hurmat kimdir haqida yaxshi fikrdir, chunki u yaxshi.
words.example: I have great respect for firemen.
words.example_uz: Men o't o'chiruvchilarga katta hurmat bilan qarayman.

words.definition: Ifyou are rich, you have a lot of money.
words.definition_uz: Agar boy bo'lsang, ko'p puling bor.
words.example: He’s rich. He can buy anything he wants.
words.example_uz: U boy. U xohlagan narsasini sotib olishi mumkin.

words.definition: A skill is the knowledge and ability that allows you to do something well.
words.definition_uz: Ko'nikma — bu bir narsani yaxshi bajarishga imkon beruvchi bilim va qobiliyatdir.
words.example: A snowboarder must have the right skills to do well.
words.example_uz: Snoubordchi yaxshi natija ko'rsatish uchun to'g'ri ko'nikmalarga ega bo'lishi kerak.

words.definition: Somehow means in a way or by some means which is not known.
words.definition_uz: Qandaydir tarzda ma'lum bo'lmagan bir usul yoki yo'l bilan degani.
words.example: He somehow had to find a way to reach the life preserver.
words.example_uz: U qandaydir tarzda hayot saqlovchisiga yetib borish yo'lini topishi kerak edi.

words.definition: Strength is the physical power that you have.
words.definition_uz: Kuch — bu sizda bor jismoniy kuch.
words.example: Exercising will increase your strength and give you more power.
words.example_uz: Mashq qilish kuchingni oshiradi va kuchingni oshiradi.

words.definition: To vote is to officially choose between two or more things.
words.definition_uz: Ovoz berish — bu rasmiy ravishda ikki yoki undan ortiq narsadan birini tanlashdir.
words.example: I voted for Billy to be our class president.
words.example_uz: Men Billyga sinf prezidenti bo'lish uchun ovoz berdim.

words.definition: If something is above, it is at a higher level than something else.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir yuqorida bo'lsa, u boshqa narsadan yuqori darajada.
words.example: He straightened the sign that was above the crowd.
words.example_uz: U olomon ustidagi belgini to'g'riladi.

words.definition: If something is ahead of something else, it is in front of it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir boshqasidan oldinda bo'lsa, u oldinda.
words.example: The blue car drove on ahead of us.
words.example_uz: Ko'k mashina bizdan oldimizda harakat qildi.

words.definition: An amount is how much there is of something.
words.definition_uz: Miqdor — bu nimaning miqdori borligi.
words.example: Can I use my card to pay for the entire amount?
words.example_uz: Butun summani to'lash uchun kartam bilan to'lashim mumkinmi?

words.definition: A belief is a strong feeling that something is correct or true.
words.definition_uz: E'tiqod — bu nimadir to'g'ri yoki haqiqat ekanligiga kuchli his.
words.example: A preacher or priest should have a strong belief in God.
