words.example_uz: Va'zgo'y yoki ruhoniy Xudoga kuchli ishonchga ega bo'lishi kerak.

words.definition: The center of something is the middle of it.
words.definition_uz: Biror narsaning markazi uning o'rtasi.
words.example: The center of a dart board is the most important spot.
words.example_uz: Dart taxtasining markazi eng muhim nuqtadir.

words.definition: If something is common, it happens often or there is much of it.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir umumiy bo'lsa, u tez-tez sodir bo'ladi yoki juda ko'p bo'ladi.
words.example: It is common for snow to fall in the winter.
words.example_uz: Qishda qor yog'ishi odatiy hol.

words.definition: To cost is to require expenditure or payment.
words.definition_uz: Xarajat qilish xarajat yoki to'lovni talab qilishdir.
words.example: These designer shoes cost more than the regular ones.
words.example_uz: Bu dizayner poyabzallar oddiy poyabzallarga qaraganda qimmatroq.

words.definition: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir namoyish qilish — bu qanday qilinishini ko'rsatishdir.
words.example: She demonstrated her plan to her co-workers.
words.example_uz: U o'z rejasini hamkasblariga namoyish qilgan.

words.definition: Different describes someone or something that is not the same as others.
words.definition_uz: Boshqacha deganda boshqalar bilan bir xil bo'lmagan kimsa yoki nimadir tasvirlanadi.
words.example: Each of my sisters has a different hair style from one another.
words.example_uz: Har bir singlimning soch turmagi boshqacha.

words.definition: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.
words.definition_uz: Dalil — bu biror narsani isbotlash uchun ishlatiladigan fakt yoki narsa.
words.example: He used the pictures as evidence that UFOs are real.
words.example_uz: U suratlarni UFOlar haqiqiy ekanligiga dalil sifatida ishlatgan.

words.definition: Honesty means the quality of being truthful or honest.
words.definition_uz: Halollik — bu rostgo'y yoki halollik sifatini anglatadi.
words.example: A courtroom should be a place of honesty.
words.example_uz: Sud zali halollik joyi bo'lishi kerak.

words.definition: An idiom is a phrase with a meaning different from its words.
words.definition_uz: Idioma — bu so'zlaridan farq qiluvchi ma'noga ega ibora hisoblanadi.
words.example: The idiom “when pigs fly” means that something will never happen.
words.example_uz: "Cho'chqalar uchganda" iborasi hech qachon hech narsa bo'lmaydi degan ma'noni anglatadi.

words.definition: If something is independent, it is not controlled by something else.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir mustaqil bo'lsa, u boshqa narsa tomonidan boshqarilmaydi.
words.example: She chose to live an independent life in the country.
words.example_uz: U qishloqda mustaqil hayot kechirishni tanlagan.

words.definition: Inside means the inner part, space or side of something.
words.definition_uz: Ichkarida nimaningdir ichki qismi, fazosi yoki tomoni degani.
words.example: The inside of the box was empty.
words.example_uz: Qutining ichki qismi bo'sh edi.

words.definition: A master is a person who is very good at something.
words.definition_uz: Usta — bu nimadadir juda yaxshi bo'lgan odam.
words.example: My brother is a master of taekwondo.
words.example_uz: Akam taekvondo ustasi.

words.definition: A memory is something you remember.
words.definition_uz: Xotira - bu eslaydigan narsadir.
words.example: The memory of my first time in the city will always be the best.
words.example_uz: Shaharga birinchi marta kelganim xotirasi har doim eng yaxshi bo'ladi.

words.definition: If something is proper, it is right.
words.definition_uz: Agar nimadir to'g'ri bo'lsa, u to'g'ri.
words.example: It is not proper to throw your garbage on the road.
words.example_uz: Axlatni yo'lga uloqtirish noto'g'ri.

words.definition: To scan something is to look at it very carefully.
words.definition_uz: Nimanidir skanerlash uni juda diqqat bilan ko'rishdir.
words.example: You must scan each person closely.
words.example_uz: Har bir kishini diqqat bilan skanerlashing kerak.

words.definition: A section is a part of something larger.
words.definition_uz: Bo'lim kattaroq narsaning bir qismidir.
words.example: The green section of the graph is the most important part.
words.example_uz: Grafikning yashil bo'limi eng muhim qismdir.

words.definition: The surface of something is the top part or outside of it.
words.definition_uz: Nimadir yuzasi uning yuqori qismi yoki tashqarisida.
words.example: The surface of the moon is very rough.
words.example_uz: Oy yuzasi juda notekis.
